title: PhD scholarship in AI-Driven Methods and Tools for Distributed Cyber-Physical Real-Time Systems - DTU Compute
description:
A PhD scholarship is available in the Embedded Systems Engineering section at DTU Compute.

The position is part of AI4SDV, a Chips Joint Undertaking project on AI-assisted methods and tools for software-defined vehicle (SDV) engineering automation. AI4SDV studies how AI can assist design, configuration, analysis, validation, and verification along the SDV engineering life cycle.

At DTU, we focus on AI-driven methods and tools for model-based systems engineering of distributed cyber-physical real-time systems. The PhD project will study methods that combine machine learning, combinatorial optimization, formal analysis, reinforcement learning, and large language models. We consider distributed architectures such as those found in vehicles, including Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) for in-vehicle communication and mixed-criticality applications that share hardware, network, and software resources.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your main task will be to develop AI-driven methods and prototype tools for analysis and configuration in model-based engineering workflows for distributed real-time systems. The exact PhD topic will be defined together with the supervisors. Relevant directions include:
  • AI-based methods that predict or approximate analysis results and then check the results with deterministic tools.
  • AI-assisted combinatorial optimization for configuration, mapping, scheduling, routing, or resource allocation problems.
  • LLM-based synthesis of models, constraints, test cases, and prototype code used by analysis and configuration tools.
  • Model-based workflows that connect requirements, architecture models, analysis artifacts, and generated configurations.
  • Experiments on vehicle-inspired distributed architectures using TSN and mixed-criticality applications.
  • More details on relevant research problems are available from Paul Pop's Google Scholar page and Silviu Craciunas' Google Scholar page.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

We expect that you have a background in:
  • Algorithms and data structures.
  • Machine learning.
  • Programming and software tool development.
  • An interest in cyber-physical systems, real-time systems, embedded or distributed systems, optimization, or formal methods.

Approval and Enrolment
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education.

Assessment
The assessment of applicants will be based on academic qualifications, background in algorithms and machine learning, programming ability, motivation, and fit with the research area. The assessment will be carried out by an academic assessment committee.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. The allowance will be agreed upon with the relevant union.

The period of employment is 3 years. Starting date is 1 October 2026 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is full-time.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Prof. Paul Pop (paupo@dtu.dk) and Associate Prof. Silviu Craciunas (silcr@dtu.dk).

You can read more about DTU Compute at www.compute.dtu.dk and about Paul Pop and Silviu Craciunas.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU.

Application procedure
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 16 August 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
  • A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
  • An example text written by you, such as a thesis chapter, report, paper, or substantial technical documentation
  • An example code sample written by you, or a repository link with a short explanation of your contribution

You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

Embedded Systems Engineering (ESE) is one of the 10 research sections at DTU Compute. Our mission encompasses the creation of insights that allow the development of context-aware, distributed, and embedded cyber-physical systems, with a particular focus on Internet-of-Things (IoT) and the computing continuum eras. Our vision is to pioneer advancements in high-tech distributed and embedded systems technology, driving change, and contributing positively to society. We strive for a future where our research and innovations form the cornerstone of technological advancements, and we're excited to include more brilliant minds in our journey. See our publications and projects here.

DTU Compute
DTU Compute – Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science – is an internationally recognised academic environment with over 400 employees and 10 research sections. We collaborate with universities, public and private organisations, and companies in Denmark and abroad, and through DTU’s startup ecosystem, we encourage innovation and entrepreneurship. We have a strong ethical, human, and sustainable approach that ensures integrity in our work. Therefore, we strive for and take responsibility for driving the democratisation of digital technologies, so that everyone has the opportunity to actively participate in the development, and we ensure a continued open, democratic, and inclusive society for the benefit of all. At DTU Compute, we value diversity, inclusion, and a flexible work-life balance. Read more about us at www.compute.dtu.dk.

title: Cloud Engineer - build the infrastructure behind smarter hiring
description:
We want to change the way we recruit

Improve Business is a Copenhagen startup, four years young, on a mission to change the way companies and talent find each other. We believe hiring should be about matching people to roles on what they can actually do and what drives them, not just what fits on a CV.

Through Improve Business Academy, we work every day with skilled academics who are between jobs, helping them turn their expertise into real, hands-on experience with local companies. We've seen first-hand how much talent sits untapped in the pool of jobseekers, and we want to put our own belief into practice: so for this role, we're specifically looking for a registered jobseeker ready to build something that matters.

And we mean it when we say we hire differently: we weigh your motivation far more heavily than your CV. A great CV is welcome, but what we really want to understand is why you want this, how you think, and what you'd bring to the team.

Because that's exactly what this is. We're building a new recruitment-matching platform, and you'll help shape its foundation from the earliest days. We're small, ambitious, and moving fast, which means the work you do here is visible, it ships, and it counts. You won't be maintenance number seven on a legacy system; you'll be right at the core, based in our office on Gothersgade in the heart of Copenhagen.

One important note: it is important for us to hire unemployed for this position, so you'll need to be a registered jobseeker. If that's not you, this particular role won't be the right fit - but do keep an eye on us, as we're growing.

The role

We're looking for a Cloud Engineer to help develop and maintain our recruitment-matching platform, which runs entirely on Microsoft Azure for now. You'll work hands-on with Azure Container Apps, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Service Bus, Azure Container Registry, Key Vault, and Static Web Apps, all provisioned through infrastructure as code using Bicep.

You'll own the reliability of our CI/CD pipelines and quality gates, which enforce linting, static typing, security scanning, and a strict test coverage floor. Practical experience with automated delivery and release safety in containerized environments is essential, and Docker is required.

Observability is a core part of this role. Our backend already ships structured JSON logging with request correlation IDs and separate liveness and readiness probes, and we'll look to you to extend this foundation with OpenTelemetry instrumentation. You should be proficient with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics to build the dashboards and alerts that keep us ahead of problems.

To collaborate effectively with the team, you'll need enough backend fluency to discuss and touch the codebase: Python, FastAPI, SQL, Pydantic, and Alembic-managed database migrations on PostgreSQL with pgvector for vector search. Our matching engine relies on an asynchronous scoring worker that consumes a Service Bus queue and computes embeddings with the machine learning model, so understanding the operational realities of ML workloads in production will be part of your daily conversations.

Nice to have

Experience with Kubernetes, or with application security practices such as session management, multi-tenancy isolation, and OAuth integrations, is a strong plus.

Above all, we value engineers who treat reliability, observability, and cost awareness as product features rather than afterthoughts.

The details

  • Contract: 6-month position to start, with the genuine possibility of a permanent role.

  • Location: On-site at our office on Gothersgade, Copenhagen.

  • Requirement: You'll need to be based in or near Copenhagen.

  • Profile: We welcome international candidates - our working language is English

  • We'll be holding interviews in weeks 32 and 33, and we hope you can start on 1 September.

Sound like you?

If you read the tech stack above and felt at home, we'd love to hear from you. We'd love to see your CV, but don't spend time polishing it. Instead, tell us what motivates you, why this role speaks to you, and about a project you're genuinely proud of. We care far more about your motivation and how you think than about a perfect CV.

Send your application to our CEO, Anne Hørsted, at anne@improvebusiness.dk. Deadline is August 4.

Please note that we're on summer holiday from 10–27 July. After that, you're also welcome to call us with any questions on +45 30 14 16 14 and ask for our Data Scientist, Ramon Souza.

title: PhD scholarship in CFD and System Analysis of an Integrable Calcination Technology for CO2 Capture in Cement Production - DTU Chemical Engineering
description:
Are you motivated to develop advanced modelling tools for the green transition of one of the world’s most CO₂-intensive industries?

This PhD position offers an opportunity to work at the interface of computational fluid dynamics (CFD), high-temperature process engineering, carbon capture, and sustainability analysis for cement production.

You will contribute to the INNO-CCUS-funded CAP-FLEX project, which aims to develop a novel calcination technology that can be integrated into existing cement plants to produce a concentrated CO₂ stream from cement raw meal. The technology builds on the pulse-fluidized FUELFLEX(r) Pyrolyser developed by Fuller Technologies and combines flexible heat input from electric heating and oxyfuel combustion.

The PhD project is a collaboration between DTU Chemical Engineering, DTU Sustain, Fuller Technologies, and other project partners. It covers two connected modelling tracks: CFD/process modelling anchored at DTU Chemical Engineering and system/sustainability modelling in collaboration with DTU Sustain. The CFD model will describe gas–solid flow, heat transfer, combustion, and calcination, while the system model will assess environmental, economic, and societal implications.

You will develop and validate CFD and engineering models using experimental, pilot-scale, and industrial data generated in the project. You will also be involved in data collection and analysis. The models will support process design, operation, optimization, and scale-up of the calcination technology, and contribute to life cycle assessment, techno-economic assessment, and broader system analysis.

You will join an interdisciplinary and industry-oriented research environment with close interaction between academic and industrial partners. The project combines fundamental modelling, experimental validation, sustainability assessment, and industrial scale-up, giving you a strong platform to develop scientific and applied competences in sustainable high-temperature processes, carbon capture technologies, and system analysis for the green transition.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your overall responsibility will be to develop CFD and system modelling tools to support the design, optimization, scale-up, and sustainability assessment of a novel calcination technology for CO₂ capture in cement production.

Your primary tasks will include:
  • Develop and validate CFD models for gas–solid flow, heat transfer, oxyfuel combustion, electric heating, and calcination
  • Use CFD and engineering models to analyze key process parameters and support process design, operation, optimization, and scale-up
  • Contribute to system-level assessment of the technology, including life cycle assessment, techno-economic assessment, and sustainability analysis
  • Publish results in scientific journals and present your work at project meetings and international conferences

We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with a background in chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, energy engineering, process engineering or a related field.

Experience with one or more of the following areas will be an advantage:
  • CFD modelling of multiphase reactive flows
  • High-temperature processes, combustion, calcination, cement production, or carbon capture
  • Life cycle assessment, techno-economic assessment, system analysis, or sustainability assessment

You should be able to work independently and collaborate effectively with academic and industrial partners. Good written and spoken English skills are required.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment

title: PhD scholarship in Fast-Tracking Innovation through Technology Implementation - DTU Engineering Technology
description:
If you are passionate about innovation and technology and wish to contribute to developing knowledge, methods, and tools that will help companies, organisations and society, join us for a PhD project at DTU Engineering Technology. You will work at the intersection between research and industry in an application-focused environment and influence how technology succeeds in practice by focusing on technology implementation in Danish SMEs.

The PhD project will study how SMEs transition through technology implementation towards structured innovation processes, e.g. to fasten the time-to-market of new products. When SMEs become established and implement new technology, they often transition from being agile, customer centric and entrepreneurial to more structured and focused on internal processes. In doing so, they lose the startup approach, which results in longer time-to-market for new products.

The project will follow the journey of navigating the complexity of technology implementation in multiple Danish SMEs over time, and the successful candidate will define and pursue a research project within this frame. Relevant perspectives include innovation management, technology implementation, human-centred design, and organisational management. The project is expected to combine rigorous empirical research with the development and evaluation of new approaches, contributing both to academic knowledge and to the advancement of educational practices at DTU.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your overall focus will be to develop and conduct research on SMEs transitions through technology implementation towards structured innovation processes. You will contribute to both research and teaching activities within DTU Engineering Technology.

Your primary tasks will be to:
  • Develop and execute an independent PhD research project within technology implementation
  • Study the impact of organizational and contextual changes on technology implementation outcomes within the context of Danish SMEs
  • Design and evaluate a practice-based toolset define the combinations of methods and tools for technology implementation
  • Collect and analyse empirical data using qualitative and/or quantitative methods
  • Publish research findings in high-quality academic journals and conferences
  • Contribute to teaching, supervision, and development of courses and learning activities
  • Collaborate with colleagues and partners across DTU Engineering Technology

The ideal candidate has an educational background relevant to innovation management, technology implementation or organisational management. Applicants must be fluent in English and Danish.

title: Business Developer
description:
Commercial decisions are only as good as the insights behind them. At SELECTED, we're building a new Business Development team to help our markets make even better commercial decisions.

As one of the first members of the team, you'll work at the intersection of business and data. Together with commercial stakeholders across Europe, you'll turn insights into action and help shape how commercial decisions are made.

YOUR TEAM
You will join a newly established Business Development team at SELECTED. Together, we work to strengthen commercial decision-making by connecting business understanding, data and technology. Joining us from at an early stage, you'll have the opportunity to influence how we work, build strong relationships across the organisation and make an impact from day one.
Working closely with Country Sales Managers, Sales Representatives, Merchandise Managers and Partner Performance Managers across our European markets, you'll help shape how data creates value in the business. You'll also collaborate with colleagues in our buying organisation as well as BESTSELLER Tech to develop commercial data products that support our decision-making across the value chain.

YOUR ROLE
You'll help strengthen commercial decision-making across SELECTED by combining business understanding with data. Working closely with colleagues across our sales organisation and markets, you'll identify opportunities, develop tools and analyses and help colleagues make better and faster decisions across our markets.

More specifically, you will:

  • Analyse commercial performance across partners and markets to identify opportunities and recommend where actions will create the greatest value

  • Develop tools, analyses and AI-supported solutions that help our sales organisation make better and faster commercial decisions

  • Drive the adoption of data-driven ways of working through stakeholder engagement, collaboration and training

  • Support our buying organisation by bringing commercial insights into product-related decisions and processes

  • Collaborate with BESTSELLER Tech to shape and continuously improve commercial data products that create value across the business.

YOUR BENEFITS
This isn't a role where insights disappear into a report. You'll work closely with the people making commercial decisions, giving you the opportunity to challenge, advise and see the impact of your work first-hand. You'll also:

  • Help build a new function with room to influence priorities and ways of working

  • Work closely with commercial stakeholders across Europe, our buying organisation and BESTSELLER Tech

  • Benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home, which is a natural part of how we work at SELECTED.

YOUR PROFILE
You're curious about what drives commercial performance and motivated by making a real impact through data. You enjoy navigating between business and analytics, and you're at your best when collaborating with others to solve complex commercial challenges. 

In addition, we imagine that you:

  • Hold a relevant Master's degree, for example within Economics and Business Administration (cand.merc.), Business Intelligence or Data Science, or a similar field

  • Have experience working with commercial data and business insights, ideally within fashion, wholesale, retail or a comparable industry

  • Understand how commercial performance, partner dynamics and product decisions influence business results

  • Are comfortable working with analytical tools such as SQL, Python or similar, and enjoy using modern technologies, including AI, to develop analyses and practical solutions

  • Communicate complex insights in a simple and actionable way to stakeholders with different backgrounds

  • Communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU
If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Business Development Manager Alex Brink Poulsen. Otherwise, send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 4 August 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the posting when we find the right candidate.

title: Drone Technician
description:
Drone Technician

Reblade ApS – Denmark

Danish Award-Winning Team and Technology

Reblade is a Danish deep-tech startup founded in 2020, developing autonomous drone systems

for wind turbine blade repair. We combine robotics, UAV technology, computer vision,

advanced sensors, and software to automate one of the most challenging maintenance tasks in the

renewable energy industry.

Our multidisciplinary team consists of highly skilled engineers within robotics, software,

electronics, mechanical engineering, and computer vision. We have several PhDs, post-docs, and

a professor on the team, and our international culture is built around innovation, technical

excellence, and collaboration.

As recipients of multiple European innovation awards and funding programs, we are rapidly

growing our engineering organization and are looking for talented people who want to develop

cutting-edge technology with real-world impact.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Drone Technician to join our hardware team in Denmark.

You will play a key role in preparing, assembling, maintaining, and testing our UAV systems,

ensuring they are ready for laboratory development, field testing, and customer demonstrations.

Working closely with software, electronics, and mechanical engineers, you will help ensure our

systems operate safely and reliably.

Responsibilities

• Assemble, configure, and maintain UAV systems and payloads.

• Perform preventive maintenance, repairs, and troubleshooting of drones and supporting

equipment.

• Prepare drones and equipment for laboratory testing, field deployments, and customer

demonstrations.

• Perform pre-flight and post-flight inspections.

• Manage batteries, charging systems, spare parts, tools, and workshop inventory.

• Support flight testing and operational deployments.

• Document maintenance activities, inspections, and technical findings.• Contribute to the continuous improvement of assembly, maintenance, and testing

procedures.

Requirements

Essential

• Technical education within electronics, mechanics, aviation, mechatronics, or a related

technical field.

• Hands-on experience assembling and maintaining UAVs or similar electromechanical

systems.

• Experience with commercial or industrial UAV operations.

• Minimum 100 documented flight hours operating medium or large UAVs.

• Valid EU Remote Pilot Certificates A1/A3 and A2.

• Strong troubleshooting and practical problem-solving skills.

• Ability to read technical documentation and follow assembly procedures.

• Structured, detail-oriented, and quality-focused approach.

• Good English communication skills.

• Willingness to relocate to Denmark.

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with ArduPilot or similar flight control systems.

• Experience supporting UAV testing and customer demonstrations.

• Experience working in robotics, prototype development, or R&D environments.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to work with cutting-edge autonomous drone technology.

• Be part of an award-winning international engineering team.

• High level of responsibility and technical ownership.

• Fast-paced startup environment where your work has immediate impact.

Location

Denmark (On-site)Employment Type

Full-time

Join us in shaping the future of autonomous wind turbine blade maintenance through

robotics and drone technology.

title: Socialpædagog søges til Børne- og ungehjem
description:
Behandlingsinstitutioner Curam søger snarest en socialpædagog til afdeling Grønnebjerg

Curams målgruppe er børn og unge mellem 14-23 år med multiple problemstillinger, herunder omsorgssvigt, udviklingstraume, tilknytningsforstyrrelser, kriminalitet og misbrug. Vi har plads til i alt 15 unge, fordelt på 3 afdelinger, ligesom vi har ansvaret for 4 unge der bor i egen bolig, alle i Skibby. Stillingen er ledig i vores afdeling Grønnebjerg i Kirke Såby, og har plads til 5 unge mellem 14-17 år.

Arbejdestiden er mellem 7.00-23.00 i et 4 ugers rul, og laves i samarbejde med de øvrige ansatte. Man skal være indstillet på at arbejde 2-4 eftermiddag/after pr uge og mindst en weekend (fredag/lørdag eller lørdag/søndag) pr. måned. Natarbejde kommer ikke på tale, da vi har faste nattevagter.

Ansøger med kendskab til arbejdet med udsatte børn og unge vil blive foretrukket, ligesom kendskab til misbrugsproblematikker og udadreagerende adfærd er en klar fordel.

Robusthed, ro, empati og mentaliseringskompetncer, er sammen med en respektfuld og anerkendende tilgang til målgruppen og dennes familie, nødvendige kompetencer.

Ansvarlighed og ordentlighed er en forudsætning, ligesom humor og samarbejdsevne er centrale elementer for den rette ansøger. 

Vi tilbyder god løn, oplæring, kurser og supervision, ligesom der er tilrettelagt en 1-årig intern efteruddannelse for den samlede personalegruppe med opstart maj 2026. Desuden vægter vi en god omgangstone, frihed under ansvar, kollegial sparring og har nogle super gode fysiske rammer, både til personalet og de unge.

Vi arbejder ud fra en tilknytningsteoretisk, systemisk narrativ og kropsorienteret tilgang.

Værdigrundlag:

  • Vi tror på, at alle børn og unge har ressourcer og styrker og alle gør det bedst de kan.

  • Vi tror på, at enhver person har ret til at blive behandlet individuelt ud fra en særligt tilrettelagt og målrettet behandlingstænkning, der tager højde for barnet/den unges livshistorie, følelsesmæssige samt kognitive forudsætninger for at kunne indgå i kontakt og relation med sin omverden.

  • Vi tror på, at professionelle, som er autentiske, træder i karakter, og som ikke er bange for at involvere sig og sætte sig selv i spil, kan gøre en forskel.

  • Vi tror på, at positive forandringer bedst skabes i et positivt defineret felt. Vi tager altid udgangspunkt i det enkelte menneske og lægger vægt på, at alle bliver mødt med en forståelse for de vanskeligheder barnet/den unge har med sig.

  • Vi tror på, at en helhedsorienteret tilgang, hvor hele netværker inddrages, er den bedste forudsætning for forandring, der også holder på længere sigt.

Kørsel i egen bil kan i nødstilfælde være nødvendigt, hvis alle Curams biler er optaget.

Med venlig hilsen

Flemming Zuschlag Christihansen

Aut. psykolog og forstander

description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. title: Lead Data Engineer (m/w/d) (Data Engineer)
description:
Als **Lead Data Engineer (m/w/d)** verbindest du hands-on Engineering mit technischer Führung und prägst die Weiterentwicklung unseres Databricks-basierten Datenökosystems. Du spielst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenplattform. Du arbeitest eng mit Engineers, Architekt:innen, Product Ownern und Business-Stakeholdern zusammen und triffst technische Entscheidungen, die sowohl kurzfristige Anforderungen als auch langfristige strategische Ziele unterstützen. Du verstehst, wie die Arbeit des Engineering-Teams zu konkreten Geschäftsergebnissen beiträgt.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für das Data-Engineering-Team und prägst maßgeblich die technische Ausrichtung unserer Data-Engineering-Praktiken im gesamten Unternehmen. Du schreibst Code, definierst Standards und unterstützt sowie coachst andere Engineers. Gleichzeitig bist du die zentrale technische Eskalationsstelle für komplexe Herausforderungen.

Zu deinen Kernaufgaben gehören:

- Die Leitung von Design, Entwicklung und Optimierung von Data-Lösungen im Enterprise-Maßstab auf Databricks
- Die Konzeption und Implementierung skalierbarer Data-Ingestion-Frameworks für Batch- und Streaming-Workloads
- Die Verantwortung für Databricks Asset Bundles / Declarative Automation Bundles, Deployment-Pipelines und Multi-Environment-Konfigurationen
- Die Steuerung von Data-Governance-Initiativen über Unity Catalog, inklusive Access Management, Storage Credentials und Metadatenverwaltung
- Die Definition und Pflege von Engineering-Standards wie Coding Practices, Code Reviews, Dokumentation und Data-Quality-Frameworks
- Das Coaching anderer Data Engineers sowie die Übernahme der technischen Eskalation bei komplexen Herausforderungen

Profil

Du bist eine **hands-on technische Führungskraft (m/w/d)** mit umfassender Databricks-Erfahrung. Du denkst über die unmittelbare Aufgabe hinaus, hast die gesamte Plattform im Blick und triffst Architekturentscheidungen mit Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit und langfristige Datenstrategie. Du verstehst die Verbindung zwischen Engineering-Output und Business-Impact und findest die Balance zwischen schneller Lieferung und nachhaltiger Governance.

Wir stellen uns vor, dass du:

- Umfassende praktische Erfahrung mit produktionsreifen Databricks-Lösungen hast
- Sehr sicher in Python, PySpark und SQL bist – inklusive komplexer Transformationen, Performanceoptimierung und Query-Design
- Erfahrung im Design von Databricks Asset Bundles und im Deployment über mehrere Umgebungen hinweg mitbringst
- Fundiertes Wissen über Unity Catalog, Data Governance, Access Control und Best Practices im Datenmanagement besitzt
- CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps oder ähnlichen Technologien aufgebaut und betrieben hast
- Architekturentscheidungen und technische Trade-offs klar und verständlich kommunizieren kannst – sowohl technisch als auch nicht-technisch - auf Deutsch und Englisch

Zusätzlich von Vorteil sind:

- Erfahrung mit Databricks AI/BI Dashboards, Genie oder Semantic Layer Design
- Kenntnisse im Azure Identity- und Secrets-Management, z. B. Entra ID, OIDC Federation und Azure Key Vault
- Erfahrung darin, GDPR- und Vertraulichkeitsanforderungen in Data-Engineering-Lösungen zu integrieren

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG wirst du Teil einer ambitionierten und kollaborativen Organisation, in der Daten eine immer wichtigere Rolle für Innovation und geschäftlichen Mehrwert spielen. Du erhältst die Chance, unsere moderne Datenplattform aktiv mitzugestalten und an strategischen Initiativen im gesamten Unternehmen mitzuwirken.

Wir bieten dir ein flexibles und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld mit hervorragenden Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung, zum Wissensaustausch und zum beruflichen Wachstum. Dich erwartet eine Kultur, die von Zusammenarbeit, Vertrauen und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung geprägt ist.

title: Molecular Biologist for the development of cancer diagnostics (Research Assistant)
description:
Department of Biology, Faculty of Science at University of Copenhagen is offering a position in molecular biology for a research assistant, developing circular DNA as a biomarker in cancer.

The position is available from 15 October or as soon as possible thereafter.

Extrachromosomal DNA circles are known from tumors where they carry proto-oncogenes and can induce tumorigenesis (DOI: 10.1016/j.tig.2022.02.007). Our recent data reveal that circular DNA is also found in blood plasma as circular circulating tumor DNA (circular ctDNA), suggesting that this new type of ctDNA can be an efficient marker for cancer. We have developed a technology for detecting circular ctDNA as a biomarker in plasma, and we are now looking for a scientific assistant to optimize and validate the method for robust, reproducible use by end users in hospital settings. This includes considering how the technology can be introduced into clinical workflows and how the existing solution can be automated for routine use. The successful candidate will work with the aim of advancing the technology toward commercialization, in close collaboration with the startup company CARE-DNA, which is working on bringing this product to market.

Description of the scientific environment
You will be a member of the Regenberg research team (Regenberg Lab). We explore the biology of circular DNA in eukaryotic systems, taking advantage of our highly sensitive methods for detection and analysis of circular DNA in yeast, animals, and human cancer from whole genome data. You will work in close contact with other scientists in bioinformatics, as well as experimentalists who purify, sequence, and analyze the circular DNA in thousands of plasma and tumor samples from cancer patients. We offer an exciting international work environment in our renowned team, with ample opportunity to develop a strong scientific career and gain insight into the startup world. The project will be carried out at the Section for Ecology and Evolution, Department of Biology, University of Copenhagen.

We expect the candidate to have:

  • Hands on experience with common genomics methods, including whole genome sequencing (WGS)
  • Experience with DNA purification and library preparation
  • A strong understanding of cancer biology is an advantage
  • Strong collaborative skills, with the ability to work well in a team
  • An agile mindset, comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment
  • Structured and strategic thinking
  • Well-organized, with the ability to document their work clearly
  • An interest in startups/spinout ventures
  • Experience from the diagnostic industry or public sector is an advantage
Supervisor is Professor, Birgitte Regenberg, Department of Biology, bregenberg@bio.ku.dk, direct phone: +4535321680.

The position is available for a 16-month period and your key task is to manage and carry on your research project.

Formal requirements
Applicants should hold an MSc in Molecular Biology or a similar discipline, and must be familiar with working independently in the laboratory. Fluency in spoken and written English is a requirement. As criteria for the assessment of your qualifications, emphasis will also be laid on previous publications (if any) and relevant work experience.

Terms of employment
The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

The application, in English, must be submitted electronically in the UCPH Job Portal.

Please include

  • Curriculum vitae
  • Diplomas (Master degree or equivalent)
  • Complete publication list

title: Postdoc in BioPhysics
description:
Many microorganisms, such as bacteria and cancer cells, exhibit remarkable collective dynamics, often described as "living liquids" or active fluids, and arise due to local internal energy injection. Likeconventional liquids, the macro-scale confinement, or boundaries, of thfluid can control their flow patterns, and the micro-scale behaviour of the microorganisms. However, many physical systems exist within a deformable environment such as the mucus layers in the body.

As a result, not only does this living liquid get affected by its environment, but it can also reshape its soft surroundings as a form of mechanoreciprocity. This leads to a range of fascinating phenomena, such as cancer cells invading surrounding extracellular matrix, soil-dwelling bacteria burrowing through sand, and the infection of mucus by pathogenic bacteria. This research project will use computational models to explore the bidirectional relationship between an organism’s motility and its adaptable environment, investigating how microorganisms not only adapt to, but also actively restructure their surroundings.

This application is posted with a corresponding PhD position and only one of the positions will be filled. We are looking for candidates interested in biophysical systems and computational physics, with a preference for some knowledge about programming.

The postdoc’s duties will include research within biophysics as well as teaching. The post may also include performance of other duties.

Further information on the Department is linked at the NBI website. Inquiries about the position can be made to Kristian Thijssen, Kristian.thijssen@nbi.ku.dk.

Terms of employment

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

title: Underviser til udviklingsopgaver og undervisning på Diplomuddannelsen i Ledelse
description:
Har du erfaring med undervisnings- og udviklingsopgaver inden for ledelsesområdet, og har du lyst til at bringe din viden i spil i et stærkt ledelsesfagligt fællesskab? Så søger vi lige nu en adjunkt eller lektor til Center for Ledelse og Organisering i Roskilde. Vi udbyder bl.a. Diplomuddannelsen i Ledelse og udvikler og gennemfører praksisrelaterede undervisningsforløb og udviklingsopgaver i tæt samarbejde med primært offentlige arbejdspladser i regionen.

Vores uddannelser og forløb står på et solidt vidensgrundlag af både praksis-, forsknings- og udviklingsviden, og vi er optaget af at levere engagerende undervisning, der fører til brugbar ledelsesudvikling. Vi er i særlig grad optaget af at bygge bro mellem kompetenceudvikling for ledere og medarbejdere. Vi ved, at nærhed til praksis har stor betydning for vores studerendes læringsudbytte og deres efterfølgende muligheder for at bringe de nye indsigter i spil på deres arbejdspladser. Vi søger på den baggrund en ny kollega, der har erfaring med ledelse i praksis på velfærdsområdet, solid teoretisk viden, og som har arbejdet med at designe udviklings- og undervisningsforløb. Vi er særligt interesseret i at høre fra dig, der kan bidrage til udvikling af praksisrelateret undervisning, og som har interesse for forretningsudvikling og opbygning af nye samarbejder.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor vi sammen udvikler fremtidens ledere.

Din profil
Vi søger en adjunkt eller lektor, der kan genkende sig selv i følgende:

Du er en dygtig underviser, formidler og vejleder. Du er velfunderet inden for ledelsesteori bredt set. Du er didaktisk kompetent og ved, hvordan du understøtter kompetenceudvikling, der skaber ledelsesudvikling i praksis. Du er ambitiøs på de studerendes vegne, og det er en integreret del af din tilgang at tilpasse og differentiere din undervisning til netop den målgruppe, du står overfor.

Du har erfaring med ledelse og er stærk i dialogen med regionens interessenter. Du har ikke nødvendigvis selv været leder, men du ved, hvad ledelsesopgaven rummer i praksis. Således har du stor viden om de ledelsesdilemmaer vores studerende og samarbejdspartnere i regionen taler om. Med baggrund i din viden og erfaring evner du at skabe koblinger mellem teori og praksis på en nuanceret måde, så de studerende støttes i deres udvikling. Herudover kan du indgå i dialogen med regionens interessenter om udfordringer og løsninger på de problemstillinger, som de står over for.

Du har forretningsforståelse og kan se værdien i det relationsopbyggende arbejde. Du er stærk relationel, har en stærk forretningsforståelse og evner at skabe gensidigt udbytterige samarbejder for både vores samarbejdspartnere og os. Din tilgang er præget af indsigt, nærvær og en naturlig evne til at skabe forbindelser, der styrker langsigtet samarbejde og løbende åbner nye muligheder.

Derudover forventer vi, at du har:
  • en relevant uddannelse på kandidatniveau
  • en bred teoretisk indsigt og erfaring inden for ledelsesområdet
  • erfaring med at designe og gennemføre undervisnings- og udviklingsforløb med udgangspunkt i praksis
  • erfaring med udviklingsopgaver og forløb i praksis og lyst til at arbejde med denne type af opgaver både i det relationelt opbyggende forarbejde, i forbindelse med tilbudsskrivning og i gennemførelsen af forløb
  • du prioriterer tværgående samarbejde og finder glæde i at lykkes i stærke arbejdsfællesskaber

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som adjunkt eller lektor skal du arbejde med efter- og videreuddannelse af primært offentlige ledere. Du vil få en varieret arbejdsportefølje, hvor du vil indgå i centerets udviklingsaktiviteter og have mulighed for at medudvikle fokusområder og konkrete undervisningsforløb for regionens arbejdspladser.

Udviklingsopgaver. Du er med til at udvikle nye uddannelses- og udviklingsforløb samt tilpasse eksisterende tilbud, så de matcher aktuelle behov i praksisfeltet. Du har en aktiv rolle i at opsøge nye samarbejdspartnere, udarbejde tilbud og sikre, at centeret tiltrækker nye opgaver og studerende. Desuden deltager du i centerets interne udviklingsprojekter, hvor vi arbejder med at styrke vores faglige profil, didaktiske metoder og samarbejdsformer. Du vil indgå i arbejdsfællesskaber både med kolleger fra centeret, Absalons andre centre og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Undervisning. Du skal udvikle, tilrettelægge, gennemføre, evaluere og justere undervisning. Du vil indgå i et tæt arbejdsfællesskab med uddannelseslederen og det samlede team af undervisere om udviklingen af vores uddannelsesforløb. Som udgangspunkt forventer vi, at du kan varetage undervisningen på grundmodulerne på Diplom i Ledelse - og på udvalgte valgmoduler alt afhængigt af dine faglige styrker og din erfaring.

Bidrag til et aktivt og spændende fagmiljø. Vi lægger vægt på, at vores fagmiljø er præget af et højt vidensniveau og glade og engagerede studerende, der selv bidrager til udviklingen af undervisningen. Vi understøtter, at alle kan få kompetent sparring og støtte i studiegrupper og fra deres vejledere under uddannelsen. Vi søger selv indsigt i praksis og aktuelle behov for ny viden og kompetencer gennem vores udviklingsaktiviteter samt dialogen og samarbejdet med praksis, herunder med nuværende og tidligere studerende.

Dine kolleger
Center for Ledelse og Organisering er et af seks faglige centre på Professionshøjskolen Absalon. I centret er vi en centerchef, en uddannelsesleder og 14 medarbejdere, der beskæftiger sig med efter- og videreuddannelse, forskning og udvikling på ledelsesområdet. Vi lægger vægt på et tæt fagligt fællesskab, hvor vi sammen udvikler vores aktiviteter. Du kommer således til at arbejde sammen med dine kolleger om den konkrete tilrettelæggelse af undervisning, udviklingsprojekter mv. Du kommer til at referere til uddannelseslederen for Diplom i Ledelse, som lægger vægt på at kombinere et målrettet resultatfokus med et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Hos os får du et udviklende job med engagerede, fagligt dygtige og motiverede kolleger. Derudover får du mulighed for at gøre en forskel for velfærden i den offentlige sektor og opbygge et spændende netværk.

Du vil få ansættelsessted på Campus Roskilde, men dine opgaver foregår i hele regionen.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 41.232 kr. inkl. pension. For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 53.537 kr. inkl. pension.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid med forventet opstart senest 1. oktober 2026.
  • Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte uddannelsesleder Jesper Bramsbye på jebr@pha.dk eller 72 48 26 48.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger, eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 3. august 2026. Vi forventer at afholde samtaler i uge 33 og 34.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Alt efter dine kvalifikationer vil du blive ansat som adjunkt eller lektor
På Absalon er adjunkturet en 4-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde.

Ved ansættelse af lektorer der er lektorbedømt før 2013-stillingsstrukturen, sker ansættelse på hidtidige centralt fastsatte løn- og ansættelsesvilkår. Afhængig af dine kvalifikationer, afvejet med stillingens konkrete indhold, kan fornyet lektorbedømmelse efter den aktuelle stillingsstruktur (fast-track ordningen) eventuelt aftales. Læs mere her i kap. 5: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2020/673

Du kan læse mere om rammerne for ansættelse som adjunkt eller lektor i vores stillingsstruktur her: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2021/1458

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

title: Social- og sundhedsassistenter til Plejehjemmet Lillerupparken
description:
Vil du gå forrest i udviklingen af byens Plejehjem?

Brænder du for helhedspleje, faglig udvikling og stærkt samarbejde – og vil du være med til at skabe sammenhængende pleje i borgerens eget hjem? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter. 

Vi søger social- og sundhedsassistenter til en fast stilling i dagvagt (30-37 timer ugentligt) med arbejde hver 2. weekend til vores kollegaer på plejehjemmet Lillerupparken. Her får du en unik mulighed for at være med til at præge retningen for et nytænkende og tværfagligt samarbejde – samtidig med, at du bringer dine faglige kompetencer aktivt i spil.

Vær med til at skabe mere selvbestemmelse – for både borgere og medarbejdere

Vores tværfaglige og selvstyrende borgerteams arbejder for at skabe større kontinuitet og kvalitet i plejen – samt mere selvbestemmelse for både borgere og medarbejdere.

  
Lidt om Lillerupparken:

 

Team 1 er beliggende på Hovedgaden 77 og rummer 3 afsnit fordelt på 3 etager (stuen: Kornblomst, 1. sal: Jasmin, 2. sal: Anemone).

 

Team 2 er beliggende på Hovedgaden 79 og rummer 5 afsnit fordelt på 2 etager (stuen: Forglemmigej og Valmuen; 1. sal: Solsikken, Violen og Margueritten)

 

Selvom du primært vil blive tilknyttet et afsnit, er forventningen også at du skal lære de andre beboere på de andre afsnit at kende, da man som assistent hjælper på tværs af afdelinger og etager i huset.

Som social- og sundhedsassistent på Lillerupparken bliver du en del af en personalegruppe, hvor samarbejdet og det gode arbejdsmiljø er i fokus
Vi arbejder tværfagligt og har bl.a. følgende faggrupper ansat: social- og assistenter, social- og sundhedshjælpere, sygeplejersker, ernæringsassistenter, ergoterapeuter, fysioterapeuter og en aktivitetsmedarbejder.


Lillerupparken rummer et stort uddannelsesmiljø, hvor der året igennem er elever og sygeplejerskestuderende. Der er ansat en oplæringsvejleder til eleverne og en klinisk vejleder til de studerende, men vi fungerer alle som daglige vejleder og er der, hvor eleverne ofte søger deres vidensdeling samt sparring.

Vi arbejder aktivt med vores arbejdsmiljø, trivsel og kvalitet, og har en forventning om at du også bidrager aktivt og positivt hertil.

 

Dine vigtigste roller og kompetencer:

  • Du har lyst til at gå forrest i den faglige udvikling og bringe dine kompetencer i spil, både i plejen og som sparringspartner for dine kolleger

 

  • Du har mod på at påtage dig ansvar, koordinere indsatser og understøtte det fælles overblik i teamet

 

  • Du kommunikerer klart og tydeligt – både mundtligt og skriftligt – og har blik for, hvordan god kommunikation skaber bedre samarbejde og pleje

 

  • Du har lyst til at arbejde reflekteret, struktureret og med høj grad af selvstændighed – samtidig med at du spiller dit team stærkt

 

  • Du er omstillingsparat, nysgerrig og klar til at bidrage aktivt til, at vi hele tiden bliver klogere sammen

Vi kan tilbyde:

  • En spændende arbejdsplads som har et stort fokus på det gode arbejdsmiljø.
  • Indflydelse på egen udvikling og teamets udvikling.
  • Plads og mod til at af prøve nye ideer.
  • Engagerede og positive kollegaer
  • Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling.
  • Engagerede, frivillige venner, som bidrager til at bringe glæde og oplevelser ind i beboernes hverdag. 
  • Klar og tydelige ledelse i hverdagen der er til stede hos dig når behovet er der. 

Se her en video om plejeboligerne i Syddjurs Kommune: http://video.syddjurs.dk/c1353/v40503

Ansøgningsfrist 31. august 2026 

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så vi opfordrer dig til at sende din ansøgning inden ansøgningsfristen, hvis stillingen har din interesse. Tiltrædelse ønskes hurtigst muligt efter ansættelse.

Der indhentes straffeattest ved tilbud om evt. ansættelse.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og aftale om lokal løndannelse.

 

Har du lyst til at komme forbi til en uformel snak?  Eller har du nogle spørgsmål?

Så er du meget velkommen til at ringe til Teamleder for Team 1, Alexander Lind Støttrup på tlf. 2344 9347 eller Teamleder for Team 2, Frank Jensen på tlf.: 2962 8894

title: Kvalitetsbevidst og ansvarsfuld trykkerimedhjælper til Grafiket A/S i Kolding
description:
Kvalitetsbevidst og ansvarsfuld trykkerimedhjælper til Grafiket A/S i Kolding

Har du erfaring eller interesse for at arbejde indenfor grafisk produktion og søger du en ny arbejdsdag med moderne produktionsudstyr, kvalitet i fokus og gode kollegiale relationer? Så har du nu muligheden for at blive en del af en solid virksomhed med høj anciennitet, stærkt sammenhold og fokus på et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Som trykkerimedhjælper hos Grafiket i Kolding vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver omfatte:

  • Betjening og overvågning af en flexo skæremaskine i den daglige produktion.

  • Klargøring af materialer samt sikring af korrekt opsætning af maskinen.

  • Løbende kvalitetskontrol af emner og justering af produktionen efter behov.

  • Pakke- og emballeringsopgaver i forbindelse med de færdige produkter.

  • Supportopgaver relateret til flexo-produktionen, herunder hjælp til omstilling, klargøring og optimering af produktionsprocesser.

Vi forestiller os, at du har : 

  • Teknisk erfaring er ønskeligt, men ikke et krav, da maskinen er forholdsvis nem at betjene, og der vil være god oplæring.

  • Jobbet kræver en god fysik i forhold til at håndtere og pakke ruller med etiketter.

  • Det er vigtigt, at man har god kvalitets- og ordenssans.

  • Jobbet kræver godt overblik, og gerne erfaring med computer/IT.

  • Gerne fleksibel ift. varierende opgaver, og god til at holde sig selv i gang.

  • Pligtopfyldende og loyal.

  • Mødestabil og fleksibel ift. overarbejde.

  • Godt humør og god energi 

     

Vi tilbyder

  • Et godt job i en velfungerende organisation, hvor teamwork og medarbejder trivsel prioriteres. 
    Der er en flad struktur, velfungerende personaleforening og flere personalegoder. 

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder da vi gerne tilbyder en erhvervsuddannelsesaftale for rette person,     som er motiveret for at uddanne sig om grafisk tekniker hos os 

  • Virksomheden tilbyder ordnede ansættelsesforhold med pension, sundhedssikring og fritvalgskonto. Derudover er virksomheden omfattet af overenskomst , hvilket sikrer gode og trygge rammer omkring ansættelsen.

Praktiske oplysninger 

Stillingen er fuldtid. 

Ønskede arbejdstider vil være på daghold, men søger du enten aftenarbejde eller har interesse i at køre på flekshold, så er du også meget velkommen til at søge stillingen.

Daghold :  

Mandag til torsdag fra kl.  10.00-17.30 og fredage fra kl.  8.00-15.00. 

Aftenhold : 
Mandag til torsdag fra kl. 12.30-21.00 ( fredage fri)


Flekshold: Daghold/aftenhold
 


Ønsket tiltrædelse 1. september 2026. Der er tale om et try & hire forløb i 4 måneder med henblik på fastansættelse direkte hos Grafiket A/S umiddelbart efter try/hire ansættelsen.


Søg jobbet
Har ovenstående fanget din interesse, søger du stillingen ved at vedhæfte et opdateret cv og en motiveret ansøgning. Du kan også skrive en kort tekst om dig selv i ansøgningsteksten ovenfor. Temp-Team A/S varetager denne rekruttering og al henvendelse skal gå gennem Temp-Team.
Grundet GDPR modtager vi ikke cv og ansøgning via e-mail.

Temp-Team
Temp-Team A/S er et landsdækkende rekrutterings- og bemandingsbureau. Vi har mere end 45 års erfaring inden for rekrutteringer til faste jobs og vikarløsninger og dækker et bredt udsnit af brancher. Vi har fokus på høj kvalitet og tæt, personlig kontakt til både kandidater og kunder.

Vi er en del af JuhlerGroup – en international koncern.

title: VEJLE - Lagerarbejde - El-hund

title: Restaurantchef søges til Restaurant Odette i indre by
description:
Restaurantchef til Restaurant ODETTE 

Brænder du for gastronomi, ledelse og den gode stemning på gulvet?
Restaurant ODETTE søger en nærværende og dygtig Restaurantchef, der har lyst til at stå i spidsen for en travl restaurant med fart på – og med hjertet med i alt, hvad vi gør.

ODETTE er en del af Norrlyst-koncernen, og vores gæster kommer for at opleve både kvalitet, varme og personlighed. Til frokost serverer vi nyfortolket dansk smørrebrød, lavet med omtanke og kærlighed til håndværket. Om aftenen inviterer vi til social dining med en 12-retters menu, hvor vi skaber små øjeblikke af nærvær og oplevelser ved bordet.

Nu søger vi en Restaurantchef, der kan være den stabile, modne leder i dagligdagen – og samtidig være kulturbærer for den gode energi og det stærke fællesskab.

Hvem er du?

Du elsker restaurantlivet – både tempoet, detaljerne og det tætte samspil med både gæster og kollegaer.
Som leder træder du naturligt frem, skaber ro og retning og sørger for, at alle omkring dig trives.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring som Restaurantchef eller Restaurantleder

  • Trives i et travlt miljø og holder hovedet koldt, når der er mest tryk på

  • Er struktureret, ansvarsbevidst og stabil

  • Motiverer dit team og er god til at se og løfte andre

  • Brænder for at give gæsterne en personlig og gennemført oplevelse

  • Er både professionel og imødekommende i din tilgang

  • Værdsætter højt serviceniveau – uden at miste hyggen

Dine opgaver

Som Restaurantchef hos ODETTE bliver du en nøgleperson i både drift og udvikling. Her får du lov til at sætte dit aftryk – både i hverdagen og i den større retning.

Du får ansvar for:

  • Vagtplan og den daglige koordinering

  • Oplæring og udvikling af medarbejdere

  • Trivsel i teamet

  • Gæsteoplevelsen og den samlede stemning i restauranten

  • Samarbejde og kommunikation mellem køkken og gulv

  • Bestilling og opfølgning på varer

  • Vedligehold af restauranten

  • Udarbejdelse af dit eget vinkort

  • Løbende sparring og udvikling sammen med koncernens driftschef

Vi tilbyder

Hos ODETTE får du en arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed og god stemning går hånd i hånd. Vi arbejder professionelt, men det skal altid være rart at komme på arbejde.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En varm, social og ambitiøs arbejdsplads

  • En flad organisation med masser af dialog og udvikling

  • Stor fleksibilitet – du planlægger dine egne arbejdstider

  • Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på restaurantens udtryk og drift

  • Karrieremuligheder i hele Norrlyst-koncernen

  • Tæt samarbejde med koncernens driftschef om at udvikle ODETTE videre

  • Gode personalerabatter og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab

  • Søde, engagerede og hjælpsomme kollegaer

Hvis du har lyst til at stå i spidsen for en restaurant, hvor kvalitet, nærvær og tempo går hånd i hånd – og hvor du virkelig kan sætte dit præg på hverdagen – så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship
description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working at the intersection of cancer biology and endocrinology. The project aims to investigate stanniocalcin-2 (STC2) as a key mediator of adipose tissue–tumor crosstalk in obesity-related cancer.

The project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative, the Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC) network, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. Though this grant, 2/3 of the PhD salary has been secured.

Employment is therefore conditional upon the successful enrolment of the candidate as a PhD student at the PhD School at Faculty of Health Sciences, and the awarding of a one-year Faculty Scholarship. 

 

Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at KMEB, a research unit focused on clinical and translational endocrinology, under the supervision of Associate Professor Rikke Hjortebjerg and Professor Jan Frystyk. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the laboratory of co-supervisor Professor Henrik Ditzel, Cancer and Inflammation Research Unit, Department of Molecular Medicine, SDU. 

The candidate will work across two complementary research groups with access to state-of-the-art research facilities. Together, the groups provide a multidisciplinary research environment with close integration of clinical and experimental research. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about KMEB here: https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/kmeb

 

Project description

Our research centers around the insulin-like growth factor (IGF) system, a key hormonal regulator in several diseases. The project focuses on stanniocalcin-2 (STC2), an IGF system member that is linked to poor outcomes in most obesity-related cancers but paradoxically predicts favorable prognosis in postmenopausal estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer. 

The aim is to examine how STC2 effects are modulated by obesity and estrogen signaling and how it regulates IGF-2/insulin receptor pathways in the tumor–adipose microenvironment. To establish clinically relevant models, the candidate will generate patient-derived xenograft (PDX) mouse models with human tumor tissue and participate in establishing patient-derived organoids and 3D co-cultures. These systems will be interrogated using genetically engineered STC2 and PAPP-A variants and analyzed with advanced sequencing, spatial, and single-cell omics.

The PhD student will:

  • Establish and analyze PDX mouse models of ER+ breast cancer.

  • Sample and process tumor and tumor-adjacent/distant adipose tissue from breast cancer patients.

  • Assess STC2 activity, IGF-2 signaling, and tumor growth under estrogen-controlled conditions.

  • Help analyze molecular data generated through sequencing and omics-based approaches.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in molecular biology, biomedicine, or related fields. 

  • Preferably prior experience with endocrinology or cancer research. 

  • An interest in working with animal models (mice) is a necessity.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Rikke Hjortebjerg

KMEB, Department of Clinical Research

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: rhjortebjerg@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)


Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date September 1, 2026

Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Deltid - Vicevært? Flyttesynstekniker? Handy-person?
description:
Din titel er ikke afgørende for os. Bare du har hænderne skruet rigtig på og lysten til at blive en del af en virksomhed, hvor vi har tendens til at blive hængende på holdet i lang tid.

Da vi skal starte nye ejendomme op i og omkring Ålborg, så søger vi et team af nye viceværter. Vi forventer at vi skal bruge 1 på fuldtid og 2 på deltid.

Denne her stilling er deltid - vi forventer at arbejdet til en start er på 15-30 timer ugentligt, men vi hører gerne til dine forventninger og ser om vi kan få det til at gå op med resten af teamet.

Det er vigtigt at du i din ansøgning oplyser, at den stilling du søger er deltid, og gerne et ønske til antal arbejdstimer.

Hvem er du og hvorfor passer du ind hos os?
Det går du fordi, du er:

Servicemindet - du nyder en hverdag, hvor din primære opgave er at sikre en god oplevelse for beborerne.

Handy - måske selvlært eller fordi du har en teknisk uddannelse, men du kan løse de fleste udbedringer i lejemålene og på ejendommene selv, som fx udskiftning af blandingsbatterier, kontrol af gulvvarmeanlæg, justering af skabslåger, mm. De ting du ikke har prøvet før, kan du gennemgå med en kollega, så du er godt klædt på til at klare det selv næste gang.

Struktureret og har styr på dine aftaler. Vi sætter stor værdi i at holde, hvad vi lover hinanden og vores kunder.

Motiveret af et fleksibelt arbejdsliv. Du bestemmer selv, om din arbejdsdag starter kl. 8 eller kl. 10 – bare opgaverne bliver løst med høj kvalitet og til tiden.

Hvem er vi og hvorfor er vi sjove at arbejde hos?
Vi er en professionel leverandør af ejendomsservice og vores kunder er udlejningsejendomme, ejerforeninger og lignende. Vi vækster og har netop vundet vores 3. gazelle. Det betyder, at der på sigt kan være mulighed for flere timer eller mere ansvar, hvis det er noget, du ønsker.

Vi har tillid til hinanden og opbakning fra vores chef.

Det betyder, at vi arbejder selvstændigt med vores egne opgaver og at vi altid kan spørge om hjælp, når vi har brug for det.

Vi er uformelle og møder hinanden og vores kunder i øjenhøjde. Samtidig tager vi naturligvis ansvar for vores opgaver og sikrer, at vi løser tingene godt.

Hvad er det så for nogle opgaver, som du kan være med til løse hos os?

Arbejdsopgaverne
•   Pasning og renholdelse af ejendomme
•   Udførelse af ind-/fraflytningssyn
•   Håndtering af lejerhenvendelser og udbedring af ting i lejemålene
•   Evt. pasning af mindre grønne områder, så som græsslåning
•   Andre viceværtsrelevante opgaver

Det med småt

Bil: Da stilling er deltid, er det ikke sikker at vi stiller en bil til rådighed, så du skal derfor forvente at du skal have mulighed for at transportere dig selv i egen bil rundt imellem ejendommene.

Vi tilbyder dig firmatelefon, tablet og et kollegialt fællesskab med høj trivsel.

Derudover kan du selv frem til en opstart, hvor du bliver klædt på af dine kolleger - som du også lærer at kende til de sociale arrangementer, som vi holder i løbet af året.

Du skal forvente at løse opgaver primært i og omkring Ålborg og Nørresundby. Da vi har kunder i hele Midtjylland, kan der også være behov for at hjælpe kolleger i nogle af de andre midtjyske byer. 

Opstart: Vi søger en profil til opstart i løbet af september, så vi er klar til at vi overtager pasningen af ejendommene til d. 1 oktober. Vi holder samtalerne løbende, så tøv ikke med at tage fat i os allerede i dag.

Vil du med?
Lyder det som noget for dig, så send dit CV til andreas@dalboege.com. Du er også meget velkommen til at skrive med eventuelle spørgsmål eller læse mere om os på dalbøgesejendomsservice.dk.

Vi inviterer løbende til samtaler og lukker stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet det rette match.

title: 6 Experienced Pipe Layers Wanted for Projects in Greater Copenhagen
description:
Rekruttering Djursland is currently looking for six experienced pipe layers for projects with our client in the Greater Copenhagen area.

We are looking for candidates with solid pipe-laying experience who can work independently and are used to taking responsibility on site. You must have the right professional skills, work accurately and be able to contribute to a professional team.

About the job:

You will be working with pipe laying, sewer installation and groundwork on projects in and around Greater Copenhagen. The work requires practical experience and the ability to get started quickly.

Your tasks may include:
- Pipe laying
- Sewer and groundwork
- Construction work involving drainage and utility pipes
- Working according to drawings and instructions
- Cooperating with machine operators, supervisors and other colleagues
- Ensuring that all work is completed correctly, safely and in accordance with applicable requirements

We expect you to:
- Hold a valid pipe-laying certificate
- Have extensive experience as a pipe layer
- Be able to work independently and take responsibility
- Be reliable, hardworking and punctual
- Focus on quality and safety
- Work well as part of a team
- Be able to understand and speak Danish
- Preferably hold a category B driving licence

We offer:
- Projects in the Greater Copenhagen area
- Positions for six people
- Good pay based on qualifications
- Proper and regulated working conditions
- Start date by agreement
- The possibility of long-term work for the right candidates
- A professional employer with clear contracts

Rekruttering Djursland is a member of the Confederation of Danish Industry (Dansk Industri). We place great importance on proper working conditions, clear communication and professional agreements for both clients and employees.

title: Bliv underviser hos FOF i Helsingør og Fredensborg
description:
Har du en passion, et fag eller en særlig viden, du har lyst til at dele med andre?

FOF København og Nordsjælland ønsker at udvide vores aktiviteter i Helsingør og Fredensborg Kommune. Derfor søger vi engagerede undervisere, der har lyst til at skabe inspirerende kurser, foredrag og workshops for voksne – i blandt andet Helsingør, Espergærde, Hornbæk, Fredensborg, Humlebæk, Nivå, Kokkedal og de omkringliggende byer.

Vi søger bredt og er nysgerrige på både dig og dine idéer. Måske er du allerede underviser, eller måske har du en faglig eller praktisk erfaring, som andre vil have glæde af at lære af. Hos FOF tror vi på, at læring skaber fællesskab, nysgerrighed og livskvalitet – og vi giver plads til både de klassiske fag og nye idéer.

Lad dig gerne inspirere af vores nuværende udbud på www.fof-kn.dk, men vi hører også meget gerne om emner, vi endnu ikke tilbyder.

Vi søger dig, som:

  • har solid viden eller erfaring inden for dit fagområde

  • har lyst til at formidle og inspirere andre

  • kan skabe et trygt, inkluderende og engagerende læringsmiljø

  • møder mennesker i øjenhøjde og motiverer dem til at lære nyt

  • kan planlægge og gennemføre undervisning – hvad enten det er et foredrag, en workshop eller et kursus over flere mødegange

  • gerne har erfaring med undervisning, formidling eller facilitering af grupper

Vi tilbyder

  • stor frihed til at udvikle og tilrettelægge din undervisning

  • mulighed for at være med til at opbygge et stærkt lokalt undervisningsmiljø

  • et meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor læring, fællesskab og personlig udvikling er i centrum

  • sparring og samarbejde med en af Danmarks største aftenskoleorganisationer

  • en fleksibel undervisningsopgave, der kan tilpasses dine muligheder

Løn pr. undervisningslektion af 45 min. uden feriepenge: 328,63 kr.

Løn pr. undervisningslektion inkl. feriepenge på 12,5%: 369,71 kr.

Har du en idé?

Vi leder ikke efter undervisere inden for bestemte fag – vi leder efter mennesker med viden, engagement og lyst til at gøre en forskel. Har du en kursusidé eller et emne, du brænder for, vil vi meget gerne høre om det.

Send en kort ansøgning, hvor du fortæller om dig selv, din faglige baggrund og dine idéer til undervisning, til underviser-job@fof-kn.dk

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende, og vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship
description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working at the intersection of cancer biology and endocrinology. The project aims to investigate stanniocalcin-2 (STC2) as a key mediator of adipose tissue–tumor crosstalk in obesity-related cancer.

The project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative, the Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC) network, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. Though this grant, 2/3 of the PhD salary has been secured.

Employment is therefore conditional upon the successful enrolment of the candidate as a PhD student at the PhD School at Faculty of Health Sciences, and the awarding of a one-year Faculty Scholarship. 

 

Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at KMEB, a research unit focused on clinical and translational endocrinology, under the supervision of Associate Professor Rikke Hjortebjerg and Professor Jan Frystyk. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the laboratory of co-supervisor Professor Henrik Ditzel, Cancer and Inflammation Research Unit, Department of Molecular Medicine, SDU. 

The candidate will work across two complementary research groups with access to state-of-the-art research facilities. Together, the groups provide a multidisciplinary research environment with close integration of clinical and experimental research. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about KMEB here: https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/kmeb

 

Project description

Our research centers around the insulin-like growth factor (IGF) system, a key hormonal regulator in several diseases. The project focuses on stanniocalcin-2 (STC2), an IGF system member that is linked to poor outcomes in most obesity-related cancers but paradoxically predicts favorable prognosis in postmenopausal estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer. 

The aim is to examine how STC2 effects are modulated by obesity and estrogen signaling and how it regulates IGF-2/insulin receptor pathways in the tumor–adipose microenvironment. To establish clinically relevant models, the candidate will generate patient-derived xenograft (PDX) mouse models with human tumor tissue and participate in establishing patient-derived organoids and 3D co-cultures. These systems will be interrogated using genetically engineered STC2 and PAPP-A variants and analyzed with advanced sequencing, spatial, and single-cell omics.

The PhD student will:

  • Establish and analyze PDX mouse models of ER+ breast cancer.

  • Sample and process tumor and tumor-adjacent/distant adipose tissue from breast cancer patients.

  • Assess STC2 activity, IGF-2 signaling, and tumor growth under estrogen-controlled conditions.

  • Help analyze molecular data generated through sequencing and omics-based approaches.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in molecular biology, biomedicine, or related fields. 

  • Preferably prior experience with endocrinology or cancer research. 

  • An interest in working with animal models (mice) is a necessity.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Rikke Hjortebjerg

KMEB, Department of Clinical Research

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: rhjortebjerg@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)


Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date September 1, 2026

Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.
