title: Solution Sales Manager (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
description:
Senior Sales Representative – Solutions Sales & Account Management (m/f/d) (Marine & Electric Power EAME)

Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do - but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

As a Senior Sales Representative, you will drive the development and execution of service solutions for MaK Medium Speed Engines (MSE) across the Marine and Electric Power (EP) segments throughout the Europe, Africa and Middle East (EAME) regions.

Based in Kiel, Germany, you will be responsible for maintaining and growing the installed MaK engine population, supporting customers with innovative aftermarket solutions, and delivering sustainable business growth through strong customer engagement and strategic account management. You will work closely with customers, dealers, service partners, and internal Caterpillar organizations to develop tailored solutions that help customers maximize asset performance and operational efficiency.

What You Will Do

- Manage and develop assigned key accounts within the Marine and Electric Power segments across the EAME region in collaboration with Caterpillar dealers and direct customers.
- Develop and execute growth strategies focused on aftermarket solutions, customer retention, and long-term business development.
- Build, maintain, and strengthen strategic customer relationships to drive customer satisfaction, loyalty, and future business opportunities.
- Take ownership of key account activities, ensuring technical and commercial commitments are met while proactively identifying opportunities for additional business.
- Promote and develop Caterpillar service solutions including parts, upgrades, emissions solutions, REParts, InSitu Services, digital connectivity, and performance optimization offerings.
- Develop a deep understanding of customer operations and market requirements to provide value-based recommendations and consultative sales support.
- Collaborate with customers, dealers, and internal Caterpillar teams to deliver integrated technical and commercial solutions.
- Identify and develop relationships with selected system and service partners to expand Caterpillar's service and solution portfolio beyond traditional engine aftermarket offerings.
- Support strategic initiatives and transformation projects aligned with Caterpillar's MSE business strategy across the EAME region.
- Act as the primary commercial interface for assigned customers while working within a globally connected sales and service organization.

What You Bring With You

Customer Focus

Ability to understand customer business drivers, align solutions with customer objectives, and consistently deliver value through a customer-centric approach.

Industry Knowledge

Strong understanding of the Marine and Electric Power industries, including market trends, competitive dynamics, regulations, decarbonization initiatives, and operational challenges.

Decision Making & Critical Thinking

Capability to analyze complex commercial and technical situations, evaluate options, and make sound business decisions.

Effective Communication

Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across different cultures and organizational levels.

Negotiation Skills

Strong commercial acumen and the ability to negotiate effectively with customers, dealers, and business partners.

Relationship Management

Proven ability to establish, maintain, and grow long-term customer and partner relationships.

Business Development

Experience identifying growth opportunities, developing account strategies, and driving profitable business expansion.

Value Selling

Ability to articulate the business value of Caterpillar products, services, and digital solutions while differentiating our offerings from competitors.

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marine Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Several years of experience in sales, account management, aftermarket services, or business development within the Marine, Power Generation, or related industrial sectors.
- Strong understanding of medium-speed engine applications and aftermarket business models.
- Experience working across international markets and multicultural environments.
- Fluent in English; German language skills are highly desirable. Additional European languages are considered an advantage.

Additional Information

- Location: Kiel, Germany
- Geographical Responsibility: Europe, Africa & Middle East (EAME)
- Travel Requirement: Up to 40% international travel
- Relocation Assistance: Not available

title: Account Manager ERP & CRM (m/w/d) (Account-Manager/in)
description:
Digitalisiere Geschäftsprozesse im Mittelstand mit modernen ERP- und CRM-Systemen...

...und begleite Kunden von der ersten Beratung bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung passender Softwarelösungen in Bereichen wie Warenwirtschaft, Vertrieb, Kundenmanagement und Unternehmenssteuerung.

Unser Vertriebsteam sucht dich als Account Manager ERP & CRM (m/w/d) an einem unserer Standorte in Ahaus, Gronau, Münster, Paderborn, Köln oder im Home Office in NRW.

Warum amexus?
Als inhabergeführtes IT-Unternehmen mit 10-15 % Umsatzwachstum pro Jahr begleiten wir mittelständische Kunden langfristig bei ihrer Digitalisierung. Als Sage Platin Partner unterstützen wir Unternehmen bei der Optimierung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse mit modernen ERP- und CRM-Lösungen.

**Wir denken in Lösungen, nicht in Produkten: **Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden verstehst du fachliche Herausforderungen und entwickelst passgenaue ERP- und CRM-Konzepte, ergänzt durch Leistungen aus unserem gesamten IT-Portfolio.

Im Vertrieb erwarten dich kurze Entscheidungswege, eine offene Zusammenarbeit und eine Kultur, die auf Teamwork statt auf Ellenbogen setzt. Regelmäßige Vertriebsmeetings, unser internes Format Sales Enablement sowie ein enger Austausch im Team sorgen dafür, dass Wissen geteilt und Erfolge gemeinsam erzielt werden.

Darüber hinaus profitierst du von einer ungedeckelten Provisionsvereinbarung und kannst direkt am Unternehmenserfolg partizipieren.

Das macht diesen Job aus

- Fachvertrieb B2B: Du unterstützt mittelständische Unternehmen bei der Digitalisierung ihrer kaufmännischen und vertrieblichen Prozesse und berätst sie zu modernen ERP- und CRM-Lösungen. Dabei analysierst du Geschäftsprozesse in Bereichen wie Warenwirtschaft, Einkauf, Vertrieb, Kundenmanagement und Unternehmenssteuerung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden passende Digitalisierungslösungen.
- ERP & CRM Expertise: Mit deinem Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse analysierst du gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden Anforderungen und entwickelst passende Lösungsansätze auf Basis unseres Softwareportfolios, insbesondere im Sage-Umfeld.
- Account Management: Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu Bestands- und Neukunden auf, erkennst Potenziale für Cross- und Upselling und begleitest Kunden über den gesamten Vertriebsprozess hinweg.
- Ansprechpartner auf Entscheiderebene: Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführungen, Vertriebsleitungen, kaufmännischen Leitungen und Key Usern zusammen und begleitest strategische Softwareentscheidungen von der ersten Idee bis zum Projektstart.
- Digitalisierung im Mittelstand: Du verstehst die Herausforderungen mittelständischer Unternehmen und erkennst Potenziale zur Digitalisierung von Geschäftsprozessen, Automatisierung von Abläufen und Optimierung betriebswirtschaftlicher Prozesse. Dazu arbeitest du mit unseren Softwarepartnern zusammen, verfolgst Markttrends und informierst dich kontinuierlich über neue Funktionen, Entwicklungen und Technologien.
- Marketing & Events: Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Consulting entwickelst du Vertriebsaktionen, begleitest Veranstaltungen und unterstützt bei der Akquise neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

Das bringst du mit

- Du hast ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
- Du verfügst über mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise im ERP-, CRM- oder IT-Umfeld.
- Du begeisterst dich für Digitalisierung und hast Interesse an kaufmännischen Geschäftsprozessen in mittelständischen Unternehmen.
- Idealerweise kennst du ERP- oder CRM-Systeme wie Sage, Microsoft Dynamics Business Central oder vergleichbare Lösungen.
- Du besitzt sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1/C2 Niveau)

Was dich außerdem erwartet

- Langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten im Fachvertrieb
- Hybrides Arbeiten mit planbaren Kunden- und Teamterminen
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten
- 30 Urlaubstage
- EGYM Wellpass und BusinessBike
- Moderne technische Ausstattung
- Freiraum für Ideen, Verantwortung und Mitgestaltung
- Ein erfahrenes Sales-Team mit engem Austausch und gegenseitiger Unterstützung
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Consulting, Projektleitung und technischen Spezialist:innen

- Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeiten ohne feste Arbeitszeiten, Teilzeitoptionen (ab 30 Stunden) sowie bis zu 20 Tage EU-Workation pro Jahr

- Gesundheit & Vorsorge: Zugang zu unserem Medical Center in Düsseldorf oder medizinischen Beratungsangeboten in unseren Regionen, sowie attraktive Angebote zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und Versicherungen
- Team & Kultur: Ein diverses, internationales Team, das unsere Werte lebt: Accountability, Respect, Teamwork & Trust. Gemeinsam gestalten wir unsere Organisation als OneVT.

description:

Quality Line Side; Luft- und Raumfahrt; Qualitätssicherung; Lean Management

Quality Line Side (m/w/d) für AIRBUS

________________________________________________________________

Starten Sie als Quality Line Side - Takted FAL A320 Family mit uns in eine gemeinsame und erfolgreiche Zukunft. Als jahrzehntelanger Spezialist und Personallieferant für die Luft- und Raumfahrt Branche sowie in Partnerschaft mit AIRBUS Operations sucht die SimpleXX GmbH für den Standort Finkenwerder einen Quality Line Side - Takted FAL A320 Family zum nächsten möglichen Zeitpunkt im Rahmen der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung mit Übernahmeoption. Sie übernehmen mitunter die Freigabe von Flugzeugbereichen für den weiteren Fertigungsprozess. Des Weiteren sind zuständig Sie für die Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Eingangs-, Funktion-, Haltepunkt- und Endprüfungen. Bei AIRBUS als Luft- und Raumfahrtunternehmen erwarten Sie anspruchsvolle Tätigkeiten in einem innovativen Arbeitsumfeld, das zukunftssicher ist und Ihnen sehr gute Karrierechancen bietet. Sie besitzen eine hohe Eigenmotivation und das entsprechende Engagement? Sie fühlen sich angesprochen? Dann bewerben Sie sich noch gleich heute auf unser Stellenangebot. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Folgende Aufgaben erwarten Sie:

- Freigabe von Flugzeugbereichen für den weiteren Fertigungsprozess
- Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Eingangs-, Funktion-, Haltepunkt- und Endprüfungen
- Dokumentation durchgeführter Prüfungen in relevanten IT-Systemen wie SAP PDA/PEA, ARP, MES
- Erfassung, Nachverfolgung und Schließung von festgestellten Abweichungen zu gültigen Produktions-  und Qualitäts-Standards (Non Conformities), in vorgesehenen Beanstandungstools oder Prozessen
- Überwachung von Fertigungsabläufen, Partner- bzw. Zulieferer-aktivitäten
- Durchführung von operativen Überwachungsaktivitäten (Surveillance) im Rahmen von Customer Protection
- Betreuung von prüfberechtigten Produktionspersonal (Lvl.1,Lvl.2), Abnahme von Arbeits- und Prüfproben, sowie Erteilen von fachlichen Weisungen in QS-Belangen (Qualitätssicherung)

Wir wünschen uns:

- Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Bereich Fluggerätemechanik, Flugzeugbau, Technik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Berufserfahrung im Bereich Flugzeugbau, Industriemechanik, Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Qualitätssicherung
- Kenntnisse im Bereich Lean Management und Total Quality Management
- Erforderliche Pakete aus der Vorabqualifikation: 3.1 und 4
- Bereitschaft zur 2-Schichtarbeit sowie zum Arbeiten in engen Räumen
- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- sowie versierte Englischkenntnisse
- Tools: SAP, Google Workspace

Unser zusätzliches Angebot – was wir Ihnen bieten und was Sie von uns erwarten können

- Möglichkeit auf Home-Office in Absprache mit unserem Kunden
- Bis zu 30 Tage Jahresurlaub

- Zusätzliche Boni: Erfolgreiche Mitarbeiterempfehlungen werden extra vergütet (Vermittlungsprämie)
- Mitarbeiter-Support: Ein hervorragender Mitarbeitersupport (schnelle Rückmeldung zu administrativen Fragen und bei zusätzlichem Support – menschliche, persönliche und qualifizierte Beratung sowie mehrsprachig)
- Sie erhalten professionelle Schutz- und Arbeitskleidung gemäß Einsatzbedingungen und Einsatztätigkeit
- Sie erhalten eine exzellente medizinische Vorsorge durch unsere Kooperationen mit diversen Betriebsarztzentren (Kostenübernahme für Gesundheitsuntersuchungen)
- Förderung durch Weiterbildungs- und Qualifizierungsmöglichkeiten bei Bedarfssituationen während der Projektlaufzeit im Rahmen Ihrer Tätigkeiten
- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss
- Arbeitgeberzuschuss für vermögenswirksame Leistungen optional
- Expat-Partner: wir begleiten unsere Mitarbeiter auch bei den besonders attraktiven und beliebten Auslandsentsendungen
- Natürlich ist SimpleXX auch in der Zukunft gerne Ihr Partner, gerade wenn es auch um andere Kundenbetriebe (sei es zur Direktvermittlung oder Arbeitnehmerüberlassung) geht. description:
As an Aircraft Cabin Engineer (d/f/m) in Finkenwerder, you will contribute to the Seat-to-Seat cable integration of aircraft cabins, transforming engineering concepts into production-ready design solutions. In this role, you will combine technical expertise with precise documentation and close cross-functional collaboration throughout the End-to-End Customization process.

- Define Seat-to-Seat cable lengths and integrate electrical wiring into the aircraft cabin based on customer-specific system configurations.
- Develop, review, and design technical solutions for Seat-to-Seat cable integration.
- Prepare engineering documentation within the ATA92 framework in accordance with applicable standards, regulations, and engineering guidelines.
- Ensure the verification and validation of engineering documentation to guarantee compliance with technical and quality requirements.
- Develop and maintain 2D and 3D designs, ensuring high standards of quality, technical feasibility, and on-time delivery.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to coordinate technical solutions and support efficient project execution.
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes and actively participate in process optimization and improvement initiatives.
- Work in Finkenwerder as part of an international engineering environment, delivering structured, quality-focused, and solution-oriented aircraft cabin design.
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

We are looking for an engineering professional who enjoys working on complex technical challenges and driving innovative design solutions. You are a great fit for this Aircraft Cabin Engineer (d/f/m) position if you combine strong analytical skills with a structured working style and communicate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

- You hold a Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a comparable engineering discipline.
- You have gained initial professional experience in an engineering environment, ideally in aircraft design, aerospace, mechanical design, or technical project management.
- You have knowledge of Electrical System Installation (ESI) and experience with the creation and maintenance of technical engineering documentation.
- You are experienced in 2D and 3D design and are familiar with engineering design tools as well as product data management processes.
- Knowledge of change management and project management methodologies is considered an advantage.
- You have strong analytical skills, work independently and in a structured manner, and are committed to delivering high-quality engineering results.
- You are an effective communicator and enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across different organizational levels.
- You have good German language skills and excellent English language skills, enabling you to work confidently in an international engineering environment.
- Benefits:

This position offers an attractive overall package with clear employment conditions and a stable long-term perspective. In addition, you will benefit from a range of advantages designed to support your work-life balance and provide a reliable working environment.

- Attractive compensation with the opportunity to earn up to the maximum hourly rate defined for the assignment.

- Permanent employment contract.
- 35-hour full-time work week.

- Attractive overall compensation package based on the Equal Pay principle.
- Flexible overtime compensation through time off in lieu or additional payment.
- Compensation in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement.
- Access to a comprehensive Corporate Benefits program with exclusive employee discounts.
- Structured onboarding and support from an experienced and collaborative team.

- Du arbeitest zu 100 % im Homeoffice von Deinem Lieblingsort in Deutschland aus und suchst einen langfristigen Heimathafen bei mindestens 30 Stunden pro Woche.

Was Du mitbringen solltest

- Du hast mindestens eine Flutter-Anwendung in Produktion gebracht und über mehrere Releases hinweg betreut.

- Du denkst in Datenmodellen und Systemzusammenhängen, nicht nur in Widgets, und bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen mit.

title: Staff Product Analyst, Vendor Growth (Product-Lifecycle-Manager/in)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Staff Product Analyst (Vendor Growth) to join our Product Analytics team and drive data strategy for our Vendor Growth business management line. In this role, you will move beyond simple reporting to shape the future of our product through rigorous hypothesis testing and by converting massive datasets into high-impact strategic narratives.

In our Vendor Growth Team, you’ll tackle high-impact challenges that empower restaurant partners to operate independently and at scale. Your work will directly improve experiences for vendors and their customers across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize partner operations, support partner autonomy, and strengthen vendor relationships.

As a Staff Analyst, you will champion a core strategic initiative focused on improving partner autonomy and operational efficiency. You will lead analysis and initiatives that help us better understand partner behavior, optimize vendor-facing experiences, and identify opportunities to reduce dependency on support channels. Your work will contribute to improved partner satisfaction, lower operational costs, and more scalable business processes.

You will operate across the product line, partnering with leaders in Product, Tech, Operations and Data to define the strategic direction of analytics for the entire Vendor Growth business. This is your opportunity to leverage deep technical expertise to champion innovation and influence how Delivery Hero empowers vendors at scale.

Strategic Leadership & Product Influence:

- Define the North Star: Develop and refine product metrics and leading indicators that accurately reflect vendor health, partner satisfaction, and business viability. Establish VSSR and related self-service metrics as key performance indicators.
- Influence Roadmap: Use quantitative analysis to look beyond the numbers, providing insights that empower Product Managers and Engineers to decide what to build and why. Provide data-driven recommendations on partner behavior and feature adoption.
- Drive Experimentation: Guide the team on methodology, design, interpretation, and decision-making of A/B tests. Champion vendor-facing experiments to validate self-service feature improvements and operational optimizations.

Technical Excellence & Scalability:

- Build for Scale: Drive the development of scalable analytics infrastructure and self-service capabilities, ensuring data quality and accessibility across the organization.
- Advanced Modeling: Collaborate on vendor behavior analysis and predictive models to understand adoption barriers and optimize feature rollout strategies.

Mentorship & Culture:

title: Compliance Manager (m/f/d) (Compliance-Manager/in)
description:
Ref. 121987 – Compliance Manager (m/f/d)

NOTHING RUNS LIKE A DEERE!

The WIRTGEN GROUP is an internationally operating group of companies in the construction equipment industry. The WIRTGEN GROUP includes the well-established product brands WIRTGEN, VÖGELE, HAMM, KLEEMANN, and BENNINGHOVEN, with their main production facilities located in Germany, as well as local manufacturing sites in Brazil, China, and India.

Worldwide customer support is provided through the Group’s own sales and service companies as well as authorized dealers.  Within WIRTGEN INTERNATIONAL GmbH, the sales-supporting functions of the WIRTGEN GROUP are consolidated, including Sales, Customer Support, Marketing, Financing, and Rental Services. The company's objective is to provide focused support and effective management of the Group’s worldwide sales channels.

Our department Global Ethics and Compliance department in Windhagen is looking for a

**Compliance Manager (m/f/d)**

The Compliance Manager serves as the primary Ethics and Compliance partner for the WIRTGEN GROUP globally, helping foster a culture of integrity, collaboration, and responsible business conduct across a complex international organization. Working closely with WIRTGEN GROUP stakeholders and John Deere’s global Ethics and Compliance team, this role supports compliance program implementation, risk management, stakeholder engagement, and the continued integration of WIRTGEN GROUP into Deere’s enterprise compliance framework.

What You´ll Get:

- modern and flexible working, part-time options, shared-leadership and much more
- excellent benefits, such as employer-funded occupational pension / life cover / income protection benefits
- further benefits such as subsidized Company Bike, FamPlus and much more
- an attractive compensation package including variable pay program

In addition to the gross monthly salary, the salary for this position (full-time) consists of various special payments. Depending on your experience, you can expect an annual starting salary of between 7,463 and 11,194 EUR in this position.

**Your Responsibilities:**

- Serve as the primary Compliance Manager supporting WIRTGEN GROUP globally, acting as the strategic interface on compliance risks, program expectations, regulatory matters, and alignment with John Deere’s Ethics and Compliance strategy
- Implement, maintain, monitor, and manage compliance program elements for WIRTGEN GROUP, including policies, controls, third-party risk management activities, training, communications, monitoring, and reporting processes
- Partner with business leaders and functional stakeholders to identify, assess, update, prioritize, and mitigate compliance risks while preparing insights and recommendations for Ethics and Compliance leadership and business stakeholders
- Support the continued integration of WIRTGEN GROUP into John Deere’s global compliance framework by helping implement enterprise policies, procedures, controls, and compliance expectations across relevant operations, functions, and markets
- Collaborate with John Deere’s global and regional Compliance Managers to identify, evaluate, escalate, and address compliance risks across multiple countries and jurisdictions
- Facilitate information sharing and risk visibility related to WIRTGEN GROUP activities globally, including support for emerging, complex, and cross-border compliance matters
- Partner with Ethics and Compliance teams, including Third-Party Risk Management, Investigations, Training, Policy, Analytics, Internal Audit, Legal, and Human Resources, to promote a consistent and effective approach to compliance risk management
- Support the development and continuous improvement of risk-based compliance processes, controls, training programs, communications, monitoring activities, and reporting mechanisms
- Build and maintain strong relationships with key WIRTGEN GROUP and John Deere stakeholders, providing compliance guidance, training, coaching, and support while promoting culture of integrity, ethical behavior, and accountability

**What Skills You Need:**

- Experience supporting or managing corporate compliance, ethics, legal, audit, risk management, internal controls, regulatory, or related governance programs
- Strong understanding of compliance program fundamentals, including risk assessment, policy governance, training and communications, third-party risk management, monitoring, and reporting
- Ability to build relationships and effectively influence stakeholders across multiple cultures, business functions and organizational levels across regions, in both English and German
- Strong analytical, project management, communication, and problem-solving skills
- Demonstrated ability to manage complex issues and competing priorities while maintaining high standards of integrity and accountability
- Knowledge of applicable regulatory and compliance frameworks relevant to global business operations.

**What Makes You Stand Out:**

- Knowledge of anti-bribery and anti-corruption laws, third-party risk management programs, trade and sanctions compliance, corporate codes of conduct, investigatory practices, or related compliance disciplines
- Experience developing compliance training, communications, monitoring activities, dashboards, and management reporting
- Ability to influence senior leaders and drive organizational change through collaboration, credibility, and trust
- Experience in process optimization and continuous improvement initiatives
- Proficiency in additional languages is advantageous

**Education:**

Ideally you will have a degree or equivalent related work experience in the following:

- Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent level in Business Administration, Law, Compliance, Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Public Policy, or a related field

This exempt position is based in Windhagen and vacant as soon as possible.

**End of Posting:** 13.08.2026

No matter who you are - you are welcome at John Deere! We firmly believe that diversity and inclusion make us even stronger. If you can identify yourself with this - then we look forward to receiving your online application in English language!

Not everyone can claim that their work contributes to the fundamental needs of the world's growing population. At John Deere, you can!

As a leading global machinery manufacturer, we produce technologically advanced agricultural, forestry, construction, lawn and grounds care equipment. In recent years, we have developed the company into a more technology focused business. Share with us, our vision of a farm of the future, based on artificial intelligence, automation and connectivity to sustainably feed and shelter our growing world. #leapforward

John Deere

title: Manager Cell Line Development (m/f/d) (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
description:
We are a growth-oriented biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and manufacture of biologic drugs. To strengthen our Cell Line Development team, we are looking for a committed leader, effective immediately, to actively help shape our processes and provide technical and strategic leadership for our team.

Your Responsibilities

- Technical and functional leadership of a Cell Line Development (CLD) team, including resource planning, staff development, and performance reviews
- Planning, coordination, and management of commercial CLD projects, from cloning through GMP-compliant cell banking
- Responsibility for cell line development of recombinant proteins (e.g., monoclonal antibodies and fusion proteins) in CHO and other expression systems
- Monitoring and optimization of the internal CLD workflow, in particular the fed-batch process in miniaturized bioreactor systems (ambr15, ambr250) and shake flasks
- Experience in the establishment of cell banks (MCB, WCB) in accordance with GMP requirements, including cell bank documentation and qualification, is desirable
- Preparation, review, and approval of regulatory documents such as SOPs, qualification plans, and CLD CMC sections for regulatory submissions
- Analysis, interpretation, and presentation of analytical data from cell culture, fed-batch processes, and quality analytics — both internally and to customers and authorities
- Ensuring data integrity, traceability, and a high standard of scientific documentation quality
- Close collaboration with Process Development, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and Project Management
- Continuous development of methods, workflows, and standards within CLD, including evaluation of new technologies and automation solutions

Your Profile

Required Qualifications

- Scientific university degree (Master's / Diploma / PhD) in Biotechnology, Biology, Biochemistry, or a related field
- >3 years of professional experience in CLD, with in-depth practical knowledge of cloning, pool selection, characterization, and scale-up of mammalian cell lines (in particular CHO cells)
- Experience leading commercial development projects, including timeline, budget, and stakeholder management
- Demonstrable leadership experience managing scientific teams, with a proven ability to motivate, develop, and guide team members toward shared goals.
- Proven experience in preparing GMP-compliant documentation, including SOPs, qualification documents, and CMC submissions
- Strong analytical skills with experience evaluating, interpreting, and presenting complex data sets from cell culture and protein analytics.
- Excellent communication skills in both German and English (written and spoken), enabling effective collaboration across diverse teams and stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in process development with miniaturized bioreactor systems, in particular ambr15 and ambr250, as well as shake flask systems
- Knowledge of cell banking (generation, qualification, and storage of MCB/WCB) in accordance with ICH and GMP guidelines
- Industry background from a CDMO, pharmaceutical company, or comparable commercial environment
- Knowledge of the application and development of analytical methods (in particular: qPCR, dPCR, Southern blot, N-glycan analysis (RFMS), HP-SEC, CEX, cIEF, CE-SDS, binding assays, etc.) for cell line and protein characterization

Personal Competencies

- Strong sense of responsibility and an independent, structured way of working
- Excellent teamwork and communication skills — at both the staff and management level
- Proactive, solution-oriented working style with strong analytical thinking
- Quick comprehension and the ability to set priorities in a dynamic environment
- High level of self-motivation, commitment, and a hands-on mentality
- Very good analytical thinking and confident scientific decision-making
- Accurate, quality-conscious working style with an eye for detail
- Enjoyment of developing team members professionally and fostering a constructive team culture

What We Offer

- A responsible leadership role in an innovative biopharmaceutical company
- The opportunity to actively help shape modern cell line development technologies
- Flat hierarchies, short decision-making paths, and a collegial working environment
- ▸       Individual training and development opportunities
- Room for professional and personal growth, and the chance to actively shape processes, structures, and team capabilities
- Attractive, performance-based compensation and modern laboratory equipment
- Flexible working hours and the option of remote working by arrangement

Your Application

We look forward to receiving your complete application (cover letter, CV, relevant references), including your earliest possible start date. Please submit your documents through our online portal.

We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of gender, age, background, or disability.

description:

title: Global Governance & Regulation Lead - Travel & Expense Management (w/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Global Governance & Regulation Lead – Travel & Expense Management (w/m/d). In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für die Definition, Steuerung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der globalen Governance & Regelwerks für Reise- und Spesenmanagement. Obwohl die Position im Bereich Travel & Expense angesiedelt ist, liegt der Schwerpunkt nicht auf dem operativen Reisemanagement, sondern auf der Gestaltung, Governance und fortlaufenden Optimierung dieses globalen Regelwerks sowie seiner Entscheidungsstrukturen.

Sie treiben die Harmonisierung von Richtlinien und Regelungen voran, etablieren robuste Governance-Mechanismen und übernehmen die strategische Steuerung der globalen Travel-&-Expense-Governance-Landschaft. Dabei stellen Sie eine einheitliche Auslegung der Regelungen, wirksame Compliance sowie nachhaltige Governance-Praktiken sicher und schaffen die Balance zwischen geschäftlichen Anforderungen, regulatorischen Vorgaben und einer positiven Mitarbeitererfahrung.

Erfahrung im Umgang mit Unternehmensrichtlinien und -regelwerken auf globaler und lokaler Ebene oder mit Governance-Frameworks ist für diese strategische Position unerlässlich.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann auch an folgenden Standorten angesiedelt sein:

- Bratislava, Slowakei- Budapest, Ungarn- Lissabon, Portugal- Madrid, Spanien- Prag, Tschechien

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sie verantworten das globale Regelwerk für Travel & Expense und entwickeln dieses kontinuierlich weiter. Dazu gehören Richtlinien, Anweisungen, Grundsätze, Leitplanken, verbindliche Vorgaben sowie Standards für Entscheidungsprozesse.- Sie definieren und pflegen Governance-Mechanismen, die eine einheitliche Auslegung, Anwendung und Überwachung der Travel-&-Expense-Regelungen in allen Ländern und Geschäftseinheiten sicherstellen.- Sie steuern lokale Anweisungen sowie länderspezifische Governance-Dokumentationen und stellen deren Übereinstimmung mit globalen Regelungen, regulatorischen Anforderungen und Unternehmenszielen sicher.- Sie überwachen Abweichungen, Ausnahmeentwicklungen, Compliance-Risiken und Verstöße gegen Governance-Vorgaben, analysieren deren Ursachen und empfehlen geeignete Korrekturmaßnahmen.- Sie gewährleisten eine faire, transparente und konsistente Anwendung der Governance-Anforderungen über alle Regionen hinweg und berücksichtigen dabei rechtliche Verpflichtungen, geschäftliche Anforderungen sowie die Mitarbeitererfahrung.- Sie treiben die Harmonisierung der Travel-&-Expense-Regelwerke voran und sorgen für ein konsistentes sowie skalierbares Governance-Modell.- Sie definieren Governance-Standards, Eskalationswege, Genehmigungsstrukturen und Verantwortlichkeitsmechanismen im Bereich Travel & Expense Governance.- Sie arbeiten eng mit operativen Stakeholdern zusammen, um Prozesse, Systeme und Kontrollen an das angestrebte Governance-Modell anzupassen, wobei die Verantwortlichkeiten für Governance und operative Umsetzung klar voneinander getrennt bleiben.- Sie koordinieren die Bewertung, Genehmigung, Implementierung und Kommunikation von Änderungen an Regelwerken und Richtlinien.- Sie fungieren als vertrauenswürdige Beraterin bzw. vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Senior Stakeholder in Fragen der Travel-&-Expense-Governance, zu Compliance-Risiken und strategischen Entscheidungen.- Sie arbeiten bereichsübergreifend mit Finance, Legal, Procurement, HR, Compliance und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen, um Governance-Konformität, Risikominimierung und die Einhaltung organisatorischer Vorgaben sicherzustellen.

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über ein Hochschulstudium in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Finanzen, Rechtswissenschaften, Public Policy, Governance, Personalmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet.- Sie verfügen über langjährige Erfahrung in den Bereichen Richtlinien-Governance, Regulierungsmanagement, Corporate Compliance, HR-Richtlinienmanagement, Finanz-Governance oder in einer vergleichbaren Governance-orientierten Funktion in einem multinationalen Unternehmen.- Sie verstehen, wie lokale Anforderungen, gesetzliche Vorgaben und geschäftliche Bedürfnisse mit globalen Governance-Rahmenwerken zusammenwirken.- Sie verfügen über mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Implementierung, Überprüfung und Steuerung von Unternehmensrichtlinien, Anweisungen, Standards oder vergleichbaren Governance-Dokumentationen in einem multinationalen Umfeld.- Sie können nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Identifikation, Bewertung und Steuerung von Compliance-Risiken, Richtlinienausnahmen, Governance-Abweichungen sowie funktionsübergreifenden Governance-Herausforderungen vorweisen, einschließlich der Definition geeigneter Korrekturmaßnahmen.- Sie haben erfolgreich mit Führungskräften und wichtigen Stakeholdern aus den Bereichen Finanzen, Recht, Personalwesen, Einkauf, Compliance sowie mit externen Dienstleistungspartnern zusammengearbeitet.- Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Travel & Expense, Mobilität (Mobility), Einkauf, Personalwesen, Finanzen oder vergleichbaren regulierten Unternehmensumfeldern sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.- Sie verfügen bereits über umfangreiche Berufserfahrung und einschlägige Zusatzqualifikationen in diesem Bereich, jedoch nicht über einen Hochschulabschluss? Dann freuen wir uns ebenfalls auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch – sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich.- Sie zeichnen sich durch ausgeprägtes analytisches, konzeptionelles und governanceorientiertes Denken aus.- Sie sind in der Lage, komplexe Governance-Anforderungen in praktikable und nachhaltige Lösungen zu übersetzen.- Sie überzeugen durch exzellentes Stakeholder-Management und können auf allen Organisationsebenen, einschließlich des oberen Managements, Einfluss nehmen und wirksam kommunizieren.- Sie kommunizieren klar und verständlich und moderieren Diskussionen zu Governance-Anforderungen, Entscheidungsabsichten und den zugrunde liegenden Entscheidungsbegründungen.- Sie schaffen die richtige Balance zwischen geschäftlichen Anforderungen, Governance-Standards, Compliance-Erwartungen und organisatorischen Zielen.- Sie verfügen über ein ausgeprägtes Urteilsvermögen bei der Bewertung von Ausnahmen, Governance-Risiken und konkurrierenden Interessen verschiedener Stakeholder.- Sie fühlen sich in einem dynamischen und nicht immer eindeutig definierten Umfeld wohl und fördern die Abstimmung und Zusammenarbeit über Funktionen, Länder und Kulturen hinweg.- Sie verfügen über ein stark ausgeprägtes Compliance- und Ethikverständnis sowie ein hohes Maß an Integrität, Diskretion und Zuverlässigkeit.- Sie hinterfragen bestehende Praktiken konstruktiv und treiben die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und Verbesserung von Governance-Rahmenwerken aktiv voran.

http://null/

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stelle(...)

Die Stellenbeschreibung kann nicht vollständig angezeigt werden. Bitte folgen Sie dem u.a. Link 'Weitere Informationen zum Stellenangebot im Internet'

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures

- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Gestamóttaka / Front Desk Agent
description:
Gestamóttakan er „hjarta“ hótelsins.
Móttökustarfsmaður er oftast sá starfsmaður sem gestirnir eiga  mest samskipti við því er mikilvægt að sinna þeirra þörfum ávalt með heiðarleika, jákvæðni og þjónustulund í huga.
Markmiðið er að taka vel á móti gestunum, láta þeim líða vel á meðan dvöl stendur og kveðja þá með bros á vör.

Helstu verkefni í starfi :
•    Veita framúrskarandi þjónustu við gesti og samstarfsmenn.
•    Móttaka gesta og þjónusta við gesti hótelsins.                      
•    Afgreiðsla á bar
•    Undirbúningur og umsjón með veislum,fundum og öðrum viðburðum
•    Notkun á hótel og bókunarkerfi Centerhotels.
•    Aðstoða söludeild við bókanir ef við á                    
•    Símsvörun og aðstoð við símsvörun á öllum hótelunum
•    Svörun ummæla gesta á netmiðlum
•    Svörun gesta í tölvupósti    
•    Almennt gæðaeftirlit
•    Umjón og yfirferð reikninga
•    Taka við greiðslu gesta fyrir gistingu og þjónustu hótelsins
•    Sjá til þess að vinnuaðstaða sé ávalt hrein og skipulögð                            
•    Skráning og sala í ferðir og selja alla þjónustu hótelsins
•    Uppgjör peningakassa                                  
•    Vaktaskýrsla á hverri vakt.

Hæfniskörfur:
•    Framúrskarandi samskiptahæfni og gestrisni
•    Rík þjónustulund
•    Góð tök á ensku, bæði í töluðu og rituðu máli
•    Íslenskukunnátta er mikill kostur
•    Lausnamiðuð hugsun
•    Jákvæðni og heiðarleiki
•    Frumkvæði í starfi
•    Geta til að vinna sjálfstætt og í teymi
•    Talnaglöggni
•    Þekking á íslandi er mikill kostur
•    Reynsla á sama eða sambærulegu starfi er mikill kostur
•    Menntun og/eða reynsla sem nýtist í starfi
•    Reynsla í notkun á hótel- og bókunarkerfum mikill kostur

Viðkomandi þarf að geta hafið störf sem allra fyrst, en leitað er að framtíðar starfsmanni

***Vinnustaðurinn útvegar ekki húsnæði fyrir starfsfólk***

Unnið er á 12 tíma vöktum. Dagvaktir vinna 2-2-3 vaktavinnu, en næturvakt vinnur 7-7 vaktavinnu

Laun eru samkvæmt kjarasamningum VR / SA fyrir gestamóttöku og hótel.

Umsóknarfrestur er til og með 17 júní 2026.

Áhugasamir eru vinsamlegast beðnir um að fylla út umsókn með ferilskrá í viðhengi hér: https://form.vinnumalastofnun.is/eures and put "260603-02" in the field for employer.

Nánari upplýsingar um starf má fá með því að senda tölvupóst á netfangið: hr@centerhotels.com

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The front desk is the “heart” of the hotel.
A Front Desk Agent is often the team member guests interact with the most, making it essential to meet their needs with integrity, positivity, and a strong service mindset at all times.
The goal is to warmly welcome guests, ensure they feel comfortable throughout their stay, and send them off with a smile.

Key Responsibilities:

•    Provide outstanding service to both guests and colleagues
•    Welcome and assist hotel guests at the front desk
•    Handle bar service
•    Prepare and manage events, meetings, and functions
•    Use CenterHotels’ hotel and booking systems
•    Assist the sales department with bookings when needed
•    Answer phone calls and assist with calls for all hotel locations
•    Respond to guest reviews on online platforms
•    Handle guest communication via email
•    Perform general quality control checks
•    Manage and review invoices
•    Process payments for accommodation and hotel services
•    Ensure the workspace is always clean and well organized
•    Register and sell tours, as well as promote all hotel services
•    Balance the cash register
•    Complete shift reports for every shift

Qualifications:

•    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a strong sense of hospitality
•    Strong customer service orientation
•    Good command of English, both spoken and written
•    Icelandic language skills are a strong advantage

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

Gestamóttakan er „hjarta“ hótelsins.

title: Iðjuþjálfi
description:
Mörk hjúkrunarheimili óskar eftir metnaðarfullum og áhugasömum iðjuþjálfa til starfa.

Um er að ræða fjölbreytt og lifandi starf fyrir einstakling sem býr yfir hugmyndaauðgi, frumkvæði og góðum samskiptahæfileikum.

Greitt er eftir kjarasamningi Iðjuþjálfafélags Íslands og Samtaka fyrirtækja í velferðarþjónustu.

BSc próf eða sambærilegt próf í iðjuþjálfun
Faglegur metnaður og frumkvæði í starfi
Íslenskt starfsleyfi sem iðjuþjálfi
Góðir samskiptahæfileikar og jákvæðni
Íslenskukunnátta skilyrði
Fríðindi í starfi

Stytting vinnuvikunnar.
Aðgangur að heilsustyrk.
Öflugt starfsmannafélag

Á Grundarheimilunum er unnið samkvæmt Eden hugmyndafræðinni. Þar vinnur stór og samheldinn hópur starfsmanna að því að hlúa að öldruðum af alúð.

Vellíðan, virðing og vinátta eru höfð að leiðarljósi í samskiptum og lögð er áhersla á góðan vinnuanda, sjálfstæð vinnubrögð og heimilislegt umhverfi.


Með umsókn skal fylgja ferilskrá og kynningarbréf. Öll kyn eru hvött til að sækja um starfið. Gott er að viðkomandi geti hafið störf sem fyrst.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

Help Shape the Future of Acute and Internal Medicine in Iceland

Are you an ambitious and enthusiastic Consultant Physician looking for an opportunity to make a lasting impact? Would you like to build a career with purpose in one of the world's most beautiful, and progressive countries?

Landspitali is undertaking one of the largest transformations of urgent and emergency care in its history. We are seeking Consultant Physicians in Internal Medicine and/or Acute Internal Medicine to join our multidisciplinary team as we design, develop and deliver the next generation of emergency services in Iceland working in a leading university hospital committed to innovation, education, and research.

Experience an outstanding work-life balance in Reykjavík, where a vibrant capital city meets spectacular nature. Physicians' standard daytime working hours are based on a 36-hour working week. Enjoy safe communities, short commutes, world-class outdoor adventures, excellent schools and healthcare, and easy access to Europe and North America.

Landspitali is developing a new integrated model of urgent and emergency care focused on:
•    Improving patient flow
•    Delivering safer, more efficient and person-centered care
•    Developing innovative pathways for acutely ill patients

Successful applicants will play a key role in developing several new clinical services, including:
•    Acute Medical Unit (AMU)
•    Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC)
•    Hospital at Home

Why join Landspitali we offer:

•    Opportunities to take on leadership roles in developing new services
•    Close collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams
•    An academic environment where clinical excellence, research, teaching and innovation go hand in hand

QUALIFICATIONS:

Salary according to the current collective agreement concluded by the Minister of Finance and the Economy and the Medical Association of Iceland. About the role We are seeking a Mechanical Technician to join our team supporting underground mining operations in Navan, Ireland. Working as part of a small, highly collaborative maintenance team, you will be responsible for maintaining, servicing, troubleshooting, and repairing bulk explosives pumping systems and associated equipment used in underground mining environments. This is a hands-on role that requires a strong mechanical background, a proactive attitude, and the ability to work independently in a safety-critical environment. While the primary focus is mechanical maintenance, knowledge of electrical systems, PLCs, and industrial controls would be highly advantageous. The successful candidate will play a critical role in supporting equipment reliability, operational uptime, and safe production outcomes while working closely with operational and maintenance stakeholders underground. What you will be doing Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair bulk explosives pumping equipment and associated mechanical systems used in underground mining operations. Perform preventative and corrective maintenance activities to maximise equipment reliability and availability. Diagnose and resolve mechanical faults, supporting operational continuity and minimising downtime. Assist in identifying and resolving electrical and PLC-related issues where required, collaborating with specialist support teams as necessary. Support maintenance planning and execution activities to ensure safe and efficient operations. Participate in on-call rotations and respond to maintenance call-outs outside standard working hours when required. Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation. Work collaboratively across site functions, supporting operational requirements beyond core trade responsibilities when needed. Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with all Safety, Health, Environment and Security (SHES) standards, policies, and procedures. Align all activities with Orica’s Charter Values, Purpose, and Strategy. What you will bring Relevant trade qualification, diploma, degree, or equivalent experience in Mechanical Maintenance or a related discipline. Experience working in industrial, mining, heavy equipment, maintenance, or similar environments. Experience maintaining pumps, hydraulic systems, rotating equipment, or similar mechanical systems. Previous underground mining experience is strongly preferred. Knowledge of electrical systems, industrial controls, or PLCs would be highly advantageous. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a practical, hands-on approach. Ability to work independently and safely in a remote operational environment. Strong work ethic and willingness to contribute across multiple operational activities. Effective communication and collaboration skills. This role requires participation in an on-call roster, including out-of-hours and weekend call-outs.

Reporting to the Chief Information Officer (CIO – at Assistant Secretary level) and working closely with the Director of Operations and Platforms, the Director of Technology and ICT Transformation will lead a team of circa 4 Principal Officers and over 120 staff, managing a complex ICT portfolio and major change programs with significant technology dependencies. They will oversee high-value service contracts with IT providers and lead the Enterprise Architecture function to align technology with departmental, Government and EU objectives. A key priority will be developing a new Target Architecture to reduce legacy platform risks and enable modern, data-driven services. Key priorities include advancing cloud migration, strengthening cybersecurity, embedding automation and AI technologies, and enabling innovative service models that support remote working and digital self-service. As a member of the ISD Management Board, the Director will champion transformation strategies aligned with the Programme for Government and DSP’s Statement of Strategy, challenging traditional approaches, continue to gain operational effectiveness from our ICT investment and demonstrating the potential of new emerging technology and paradigms (such as proactive customer service). Strategic initiatives will include providing strategic oversight and evaluation of enterprise architecture decisions, including the replacement and/or re-platforming of legacy monolithic platforms, implementing enhanced proactive service for our customers and implementing a core pillar of the government’s Digital Public Service Plan 2030 (such as Life Events services). The Director will sit on the ISD Management Board and lead strategies such as the ICT, Data, AI and Cloud Strategies, and contribute to implementing strategies such as the Security and IT Skills, ensuring alignment with the Programme for Government and the Department’s Statement of Strategy and acting as a thought leader and advocate for digital transformation. This role faces significant challenges: maintaining continuous service delivery while modernising systems, meeting growing demand for ICT services and data, ensuring compliance with GDPR, ISO 27001 and NIS2, strengthening cybersecurity, and leveraging automation technologies including AI. An understanding of social welfare and employment services, or the ability to quickly acquire it, will be important, alongside the ability to develop practical and innovative ICT solutions. The ideal candidate will have proven experience in ICT transformation and large-scale change programmes, strong stakeholder engagement and contract management skills. Further information regarding the post and candidate requirements is set out in the Candidate Information Booklet. To download the Candidate Information Booklet and access the link to apply, please visit www.gov.ie/dspcareers. Candidate queries in relation to the campaign can be sent to ICTRecruitment@welfare.ie

Lectures are delivered online one day per week. Upon successful completion of all programme requirements, apprentices will be awarded a Bachelor of Science (Honours) Degree in Quantity Surveying (Level 8) on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ).
