title: Researcher bridging immunology, genomics and proteomics (academic-industry collaboration)
description:
About the position

Applicants are invited to apply for a two-year Researcher position (SKO 1109) in immuno-proteomics (hands-on biology). The position is based at the Department of Immunology, Division of Laboratory Medicine, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo.

The position is available from July 2026 with a flexible start date between July and September 2026. It is a full-time role physically based at GSK Vaccines S.r.l. in Siena, Italy, within the MS Structural Biology, Ab Discovery and Immunology unit. Scientific advising and guidance will be provided by Dr. Greiff (Lab for Computational and Systems Immunology, greifflab.org).

The researcher will develop and establish an Ig-seq platform bridging immunoglobulin profiling, B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoire sequencing and serology.


More about the position

The proposed project aims to investigate the polyclonal humoral immune response to a model viral antigen in human samples from pre-exposed individuals. This research integrates advanced techniques, including antigen-specific B-cell sorting, B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing, and LC-MS/MS-based identification of circulating antigen-specific antibodies. The goal is to link B-cell clonotypes to serum immunoglobulins and resolve functional proteoforms through an immunoproteogenomics approach. The project will involve developing de novo sequencing workflows for antigen-specific antibodies, building proteogenomic pipelines to assemble VH/VL sequences and identify clonotypes. Data will be integrated matching BCR repertoires of PBMCs, tonsil tissue, and matched sera from GSK human biological samples. Computational modeling and machine learning will be essential for antibody identification, epitope prioritization, and cross-cohort comparisons.

The project focuses on deconvoluting pathogen-specific humoral responses to a seasonal viral pathogen by combining paired BCR repertoire sequencing with antigen-resolved LC-MS/MS proteomics. The candidate's responsibilities will encompass the development and analysis of mass spectrometry methods for antibody isolation and characterization, as well as designing and validating multiparameter flow cytometry panels for antigen-specific B-cell and plasma cell identification and sorting. The role demands rigorous data stewardship, collaboration with immunology, proteomics, and bioinformatics teams, primarily at GSK Siena, and contributing to the dissemination of research findings.


Key Duties 
  • BCR library preparation and sequencing workflows,
  • Implementing bioinformatics pipelines for clonotyping, lineage tracing, and proteogenomic integration
  • Performing comparative analyses with published datasets.

 Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Appointment to the position of researcher in position code 1109 requires a doctoral degree in Proteomics
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS method development for proteins/antibodies, including sample prep, instrument setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python/R and scientific computing, and reproducible research practices (Git, containers/workflows).
  • Ability to build and run bioinformatic pipelines (de novo peptide sequencing, spectral annotation, FDR control).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Expertise in immune receptor immunology (BCR/TCR) and repertoire analytics (clonotyping, lineage tracing, SHM, germline inference).
  • Experience with BCR repertoire analysis (Bulk and/or single cell)
  • Experience with advanced Flow Cytometry and Cell Sorting.
  • Structural biology/protein informatics relevant to antibody-antigen interactions and developability assessment.
  • Experience with complementary fragmentation methods (HCD/ETD/EThcD), intact/middle-down workflows, and disulfide/glycoform mapping.
  • High-performance/parallel computing; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and benchmarking.
  • Prior experience integrating proteomics and repertoire sequencing (immunoproteogenomics)
     

Personal skills
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in an interdisciplinary, ambitious environment.
  • Independent, solution-oriented, and organised; strong scientific rigor and documentation practices
     

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

 

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A scientifically rich, interdisciplinary and international environment at GSK Siena with access to state-of-the-art proteomics and flow cytometry facilities.
  • Advising and mentorship by Prof. Victor Greiff; opportunities for collaboration across immunology, proteomics, and computational teams.
  • Professional development, training, and conference participation.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 640 000 to 760 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter.
  • CV.
  • A complete list of publications.
  • Project/research plan aligned with the position scope
  • Transcripts and certificates.
  • Contact information for 2-3 references.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to  Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. title: Researcher bridging immunology, genomics and proteomics (academic-industry collaboration)
description:
About the position

Applicants are invited to apply for a two-year Researcher position (SKO 1109) in immuno-proteomics (hands-on biology). The position is based at the Department of Immunology, Division of Laboratory Medicine, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo.

The position is available from July 2026 with a flexible start date between July and September 2026. It is a full-time role physically based at GSK Vaccines S.r.l. in Siena, Italy, within the MS Structural Biology, Ab Discovery and Immunology unit. Scientific advising and guidance will be provided by Dr. Greiff (Lab for Computational and Systems Immunology, greifflab.org).

The researcher will develop and establish an Ig-seq platform bridging immunoglobulin profiling, B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoire sequencing and serology.


More about the position

The proposed project aims to investigate the polyclonal humoral immune response to a model viral antigen in human samples from pre-exposed individuals. This research integrates advanced techniques, including antigen-specific B-cell sorting, B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing, and LC-MS/MS-based identification of circulating antigen-specific antibodies. The goal is to link B-cell clonotypes to serum immunoglobulins and resolve functional proteoforms through an immunoproteogenomics approach. The project will involve developing de novo sequencing workflows for antigen-specific antibodies, building proteogenomic pipelines to assemble VH/VL sequences and identify clonotypes. Data will be integrated matching BCR repertoires of PBMCs, tonsil tissue, and matched sera from GSK human biological samples. Computational modeling and machine learning will be essential for antibody identification, epitope prioritization, and cross-cohort comparisons.

The project focuses on deconvoluting pathogen-specific humoral responses to a seasonal viral pathogen by combining paired BCR repertoire sequencing with antigen-resolved LC-MS/MS proteomics. The candidate's responsibilities will encompass the development and analysis of mass spectrometry methods for antibody isolation and characterization, as well as designing and validating multiparameter flow cytometry panels for antigen-specific B-cell and plasma cell identification and sorting. The role demands rigorous data stewardship, collaboration with immunology, proteomics, and bioinformatics teams, primarily at GSK Siena, and contributing to the dissemination of research findings.


Key Duties 
  • BCR library preparation and sequencing workflows,
  • Implementing bioinformatics pipelines for clonotyping, lineage tracing, and proteogenomic integration
  • Performing comparative analyses with published datasets.

 Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Appointment to the position of researcher in position code 1109 requires a doctoral degree in Proteomics
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS method development for proteins/antibodies, including sample prep, instrument setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python/R and scientific computing, and reproducible research practices (Git, containers/workflows).
  • Ability to build and run bioinformatic pipelines (de novo peptide sequencing, spectral annotation, FDR control).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Expertise in immune receptor immunology (BCR/TCR) and repertoire analytics (clonotyping, lineage tracing, SHM, germline inference).
  • Experience with BCR repertoire analysis (Bulk and/or single cell)
  • Experience with advanced Flow Cytometry and Cell Sorting.
  • Structural biology/protein informatics relevant to antibody-antigen interactions and developability assessment.
  • Experience with complementary fragmentation methods (HCD/ETD/EThcD), intact/middle-down workflows, and disulfide/glycoform mapping.
  • High-performance/parallel computing; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and benchmarking.
  • Prior experience integrating proteomics and repertoire sequencing (immunoproteogenomics)
     

Personal skills
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in an interdisciplinary, ambitious environment.
  • Independent, solution-oriented, and organised; strong scientific rigor and documentation practices
     

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

 

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A scientifically rich, interdisciplinary and international environment at GSK Siena with access to state-of-the-art proteomics and flow cytometry facilities.
  • Advising and mentorship by Prof. Victor Greiff; opportunities for collaboration across immunology, proteomics, and computational teams.
  • Professional development, training, and conference participation.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 640 000 to 760 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter.
  • CV.
  • A complete list of publications.
  • Project/research plan aligned with the position scope
  • Transcripts and certificates.
  • Contact information for 2-3 references.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to  Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per azienda farmaceutica italiana specializzata nella produzione conto terzi di farmaci non sterili, selezioniamo per sito ad ANAGNI (FR): TECNICO DI LABORATORIO MICROBIOLOGICO - QC MICROBIOLOGICO con esperienza maturata preferibilmente nell'ambito di aziende farmaceutiche. La risorsa si occuperà di: Eseguire le analisi su materie prime, controlli di processo, prodotti semi-finiti e finiti. Eseguire i monitoraggi microbiologici nelle aree classificate di produzione, convalide analitiche e di processo. Eseguire le analisi secondo la procedura approvata per il mantenimento in stato di qualifica della strumentazione di laboratorio. Valutare i risultati analitici ottenuti e dare aggiornamento al responsabile di Laboratorio circa eventuali risultati fuori specifica OOS/OOT. Seguire ed applicare correttamente le procedure di laboratorio ed aziendali. Fornire supporto analitico alla valutazione del dato di analisi e alla verifica delle analisi dei colleghi. Partecipare al mantenimento del buon stato del laboratorio, delle attrezzature e dei materiali in uso. Partecipare al monitoraggio dell'approvvigionamento e la scorta del materiale necessario per eseguire i test analitici nel laboratorio. Seguire ed applicare correttamente le procedure di sicurezza durante le attività all'interno del laboratorio partecipando ad evidenziare punti critici. Applicare le norme GMP all'interno del laboratorio. Rispettare la pianificazione e la schedulazione delle attività analitiche partecipando alla definizione, alla standardizzazione ed al miglioramento dei tempi analitici. Requisiti: Laurea triennale o magistrale in Microbiologia, Biologia, Biotecnologie o discipline affini. Preferibile pregressa esperienza di 6 anno in un laboratorio microbiologico, preferibilmente nel settore farmaceutico. Conoscenza approfondita delle tecniche microbiologiche e delle normative GMP. Capacità di utilizzare strumentazione di laboratorio avanzata, come autoclavi, cappe e microscopi. Ottime capacità analitiche e attenzione ai dettagli. Buone capacità comunicative e attitudine al lavoro di squadra. Capacità di gestire il tempo in modo efficiente e di lavorare sotto pressione. title: geologo/geologa
description: Grafton ICT* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito AI, Data, Cybersecurity, Cloud, ERP & CRM, Sistemi e Infrastrutture, IMAC e Sviluppo. Per ampliamento nostro network di candidati specializzati, ricerchiamo candidati e candidate interessati/e a valutare opportunità come: RAMS / ILS ENGINEER Le posizioni che potremo proporti potranno includere attività quali: Guidare le attività RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety) lungo il ciclo di vita del prodotto; definire gli obiettivi RAM, allocare i requisiti e pianificare i programmi RAM (previsioni, suddivisione, crescita). Eseguire analisi di affidabilità (MIL-HDBK-217F, parts-count/physics-of-failure), modellazione di disponibilità e costi del ciclo di vita (MTBF/MTTR, Ao) e analisi di manutenibilità (tempi delle attività, dimostrazioni di manutenibilità). Realizzare ingegneria della sicurezza secondo ARP4754A/ARP4761 e MIL-STD-882E: FHA, FTA/ETA, PRA, classificazione dei rischi e monitoraggio delle mitigazioni. Implementare e gestire il processo FRACAS per la raccolta dei difetti di campo/test, analisi delle cause radice, azioni correttive/preventive e crescita dell'affidabilità (es. Crow-AMSAA). Guidare l'Integrated Product Support (IPS/ILS): LSA/LSAR secondo ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F); sviluppare banche dati di supporto logistico (LSDB), elenchi ricambi, attrezzature di supporto (STTE), piani di manutenzione e allineamento della documentazione tecnica (S1000D). Condurre analisi FMEA/FMECA e MTA/RCM; raccomandare modifiche progettuali e miglioramenti alla supportabilità (DfR, DfM, DfS, DfMtn). Gestire la governance dell'obsolescenza: monitoraggio del ciclo di vita, pianificazione Last Time Buy (LTB), ricerca di soluzioni Fit-Form-Function (FFF) alternative, analisi degli impatti d'uso e report di chiusura. Definire i supporti ai test e qualifiche (ambientale/elettrica/EMC) e contribuire alle verifiche di conformità ed accettazione (FAT/SAT). Realizzare dashboard e monitoraggio KPI per le performance RAMS/ILS; pubblicare report periodici e supportare i review di progetto (SRR/PDR/CDR). Mantenere un solido controllo di configurazione in PLM/ERP; garantire la conformità a qualità (ISO 9001/EN 9100), HSE e alle politiche di sicurezza delle informazioni/export-control. Hai queste caratteristiche? Laurea triennale o magistrale in Ingegneria o discipline STEM affini. Competenza nell'uso di strumenti RAMS (es. Windchill Quality Solutions/ReliaSoft), sistemi di requisiti/PLM/ERP (es. DOORS/DOORS Next, Teamcenter, SAP) e analisi dati (Excel/Power BI; SQL). Conoscenza degli standard ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F), MIL-STD-1388 (LSA/LSAR) e dei principali framework di safety engineering (ARP4754A/ARP4761, MIL-STD-882E). Capacità di redigere documentazione tecnica in inglese (report di supportabilità, FMECA/FHA/FTA, piani di manutenzione, estratti LSDB) e di gestire baseline/variazioni di configurazione. Luogo di lavoro: Roma, Genova, Torino, Firenze Entrando nel nostro data-base, potremo contattarti quando saranno disponibili posizioni coerenti con la tua esperienza, le tue competenze e la tua disponibilità. title: Mining, manufacturing and construction supervisors
description: Per conto di una realtà industriale strutturata, operante in ambito Alimentare, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Head of Quality (QHSE). La posizione riveste un ruolo strategico all'interno dell'organizzazione e prevede la responsabilità complessiva della definizione, implementazione e governo dei sistemi di qualità, sicurezza e conformità lungo l'intera catena del valore. Il contesto è caratterizzato da processi produttivi complessi, elevati standard operativi e un'interazione costante con stakeholder interni ed esterni, tra cui clienti, enti certificatori e autorità competenti. La figura contribuirà in modo diretto al presidio e all'evoluzione del Sistema di Gestione Qualità (SGQ/QMS), assicurando il rispetto degli standard normativi e delle best practice di settore e promuovendo una cultura diffusa orientata al miglioramento continuo (CI). In questo ambito, avrà la responsabilità di definire la strategia qualità, supportando il top management nell'individuazione e nella gestione dei rischi legati a qualità, sicurezza e compliance. Tra le principali responsabilità rientrano la gestione e il continuo aggiornamento dei sistemi di qualità, con riferimento ai principali standard, tra cui HACCP, IFS e ISO, nonché la supervisione delle policy aziendali e della documentazione tecnica. La risorsa sarà responsabile della gestione strutturata delle non conformità e dei reclami, attraverso l'implementazione di processi CAPA e attività di root cause analysis, e guiderà il monitoraggio dei KPI di qualità e performance, contribuendo allo sviluppo di iniziative di miglioramento continuo. Il ruolo prevede inoltre la supervisione degli audit interni, delle verifiche da parte dei clienti e degli enti certificatori, nonché la gestione delle relazioni con organismi di controllo e fornitori. Sarà inoltre responsabile del mantenimento e dello sviluppo delle certificazioni aziendali e del presidio dei processi di qualifica e monitoraggio dei fornitori. Dal punto di vista organizzativo, la figura guiderà il team qualità, coordinando risorse tecniche e laboratori, e rappresenterà un punto di riferimento trasversale per le principali funzioni aziendali, tra cui Produzione, Supply Chain, Acquisti e Manutenzione. Avrà inoltre un ruolo chiave nel garantire la coerenza tra gli standard definiti e la loro applicazione operativa nei processi produttivi, con particolare attenzione agli aspetti di sicurezza, igiene, tracciabilità e conformità documentale. Il profilo ideale ha maturato un'esperienza consolidata in ruoli di responsabilità nella funzione qualità, all'interno di contesti produttivi strutturati, e possiede una solida conoscenza dei sistemi SGQ/QMS e dei principali standard normativi e di certificazione. Completano il profilo una spiccata leadership, capacità di operare in contesti complessi, forte orientamento al risultato e al miglioramento continuo, nonché eccellenti capacità relazionali e di gestione degli stakeholder. La posizione si inserisce in un contesto dinamico e in evoluzione, offrendo la possibilità di contribuire in maniera significativa allo sviluppo dei processi e al rafforzamento del sistema qualità aziendale. #LI-CP Wyser è il brand globale che si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive di Gi Group Holding, la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro e una tra le principali realtà che offrono servizi e consulenza HR a livello globale. description: Grafton ICT* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito AI, Data, Cybersecurity, Cloud, ERP & CRM, Sistemi e Infrastrutture, IMAC e Sviluppo. Per ampliamento nostro network di candidati specializzati, ricerchiamo candidati e candidate interessati/e a valutare opportunità come: RAMS / ILS ENGINEER Le posizioni che potremo proporti potranno includere attività quali: Guidare le attività RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety) lungo il ciclo di vita del prodotto; definire gli obiettivi RAM, allocare i requisiti e pianificare i programmi RAM (previsioni, suddivisione, crescita). Eseguire analisi di affidabilità (MIL-HDBK-217F, parts-count/physics-of-failure), modellazione di disponibilità e costi del ciclo di vita (MTBF/MTTR, Ao) e analisi di manutenibilità (tempi delle attività, dimostrazioni di manutenibilità). Realizzare ingegneria della sicurezza secondo ARP4754A/ARP4761 e MIL-STD-882E: FHA, FTA/ETA, PRA, classificazione dei rischi e monitoraggio delle mitigazioni. Implementare e gestire il processo FRACAS per la raccolta dei difetti di campo/test, analisi delle cause radice, azioni correttive/preventive e crescita dell'affidabilità (es. Crow-AMSAA). Guidare l'Integrated Product Support (IPS/ILS): LSA/LSAR secondo ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F); sviluppare banche dati di supporto logistico (LSDB), elenchi ricambi, attrezzature di supporto (STTE), piani di manutenzione e allineamento della documentazione tecnica (S1000D). Condurre analisi FMEA/FMECA e MTA/RCM; raccomandare modifiche progettuali e miglioramenti alla supportabilità (DfR, DfM, DfS, DfMtn). Gestire la governance dell'obsolescenza: monitoraggio del ciclo di vita, pianificazione Last Time Buy (LTB), ricerca di soluzioni Fit-Form-Function (FFF) alternative, analisi degli impatti d'uso e report di chiusura. Definire i supporti ai test e qualifiche (ambientale/elettrica/EMC) e contribuire alle verifiche di conformità ed accettazione (FAT/SAT). Realizzare dashboard e monitoraggio KPI per le performance RAMS/ILS; pubblicare report periodici e supportare i review di progetto (SRR/PDR/CDR). Mantenere un solido controllo di configurazione in PLM/ERP; garantire la conformità a qualità (ISO 9001/EN 9100), HSE e alle politiche di sicurezza delle informazioni/export-control. Hai queste caratteristiche? Laurea triennale o magistrale in Ingegneria o discipline STEM affini. Competenza nell'uso di strumenti RAMS (es. Windchill Quality Solutions/ReliaSoft), sistemi di requisiti/PLM/ERP (es. DOORS/DOORS Next, Teamcenter, SAP) e analisi dati (Excel/Power BI; SQL). Conoscenza degli standard ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F), MIL-STD-1388 (LSA/LSAR) e dei principali framework di safety engineering (ARP4754A/ARP4761, MIL-STD-882E). Capacità di redigere documentazione tecnica in inglese (report di supportabilità, FMECA/FHA/FTA, piani di manutenzione, estratti LSDB) e di gestire baseline/variazioni di configurazione. Luogo di lavoro: Roma, Genova, Torino, Firenze Entrando nel nostro data-base, potremo contattarti quando saranno disponibili posizioni coerenti con la tua esperienza, le tue competenze e la tua disponibilità. Principali attività: - Pianificare e organizzare le spedizioni in Italia, Europa e Paesi extra UE. - Coordinare i flussi logistici in uscita dallo stabilimento, in accordo con produzione e magazzino. - Verificare la disponibilità della merce, le date di carico e le priorità di consegna. - Organizzare trasporti tramite camion dedicati, collettame, intermodale e spedizioni via nave. - Gestire i rapporti operativi con trasportatori, spedizionieri, broker e partner logistici. - Richiedere, confrontare e negoziare quotazioni di trasporto, ricercando le migliori condizioni economiche e di servizio. - Monitorare l'andamento delle spedizioni fino alla consegna finale. - Gestire eventuali ritardi, problematiche operative, anomalie documentali o contestazioni. - Predisporre e controllare la documentazione necessaria per spedizioni nazionali, intracomunitarie ed extra UE. - Collaborare con il reparto commerciale per recepire esigenze specifiche dei clienti in termini di consegna, tempi, modalità di carico, etichettatura o documentazione. title: Researcher bridging immunology, genomics and proteomics (academic-industry collaboration)
description:
About the position

Applicants are invited to apply for a two-year Researcher position (SKO 1109) in immuno-proteomics (hands-on biology). The position is based at the Department of Immunology, Division of Laboratory Medicine, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo.

The position is available from July 2026 with a flexible start date between July and September 2026. It is a full-time role physically based at GSK Vaccines S.r.l. in Siena, Italy, within the MS Structural Biology, Ab Discovery and Immunology unit. Scientific advising and guidance will be provided by Dr. Greiff (Lab for Computational and Systems Immunology, greifflab.org).

The researcher will develop and establish an Ig-seq platform bridging immunoglobulin profiling, B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoire sequencing and serology.


More about the position

The proposed project aims to investigate the polyclonal humoral immune response to a model viral antigen in human samples from pre-exposed individuals. This research integrates advanced techniques, including antigen-specific B-cell sorting, B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing, and LC-MS/MS-based identification of circulating antigen-specific antibodies. The goal is to link B-cell clonotypes to serum immunoglobulins and resolve functional proteoforms through an immunoproteogenomics approach. The project will involve developing de novo sequencing workflows for antigen-specific antibodies, building proteogenomic pipelines to assemble VH/VL sequences and identify clonotypes. Data will be integrated matching BCR repertoires of PBMCs, tonsil tissue, and matched sera from GSK human biological samples. Computational modeling and machine learning will be essential for antibody identification, epitope prioritization, and cross-cohort comparisons.

The project focuses on deconvoluting pathogen-specific humoral responses to a seasonal viral pathogen by combining paired BCR repertoire sequencing with antigen-resolved LC-MS/MS proteomics. The candidate's responsibilities will encompass the development and analysis of mass spectrometry methods for antibody isolation and characterization, as well as designing and validating multiparameter flow cytometry panels for antigen-specific B-cell and plasma cell identification and sorting. The role demands rigorous data stewardship, collaboration with immunology, proteomics, and bioinformatics teams, primarily at GSK Siena, and contributing to the dissemination of research findings.


Key Duties 
  • BCR library preparation and sequencing workflows,
  • Implementing bioinformatics pipelines for clonotyping, lineage tracing, and proteogenomic integration
  • Performing comparative analyses with published datasets.

 Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Appointment to the position of researcher in position code 1109 requires a doctoral degree in Proteomics
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS method development for proteins/antibodies, including sample prep, instrument setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python/R and scientific computing, and reproducible research practices (Git, containers/workflows).
  • Ability to build and run bioinformatic pipelines (de novo peptide sequencing, spectral annotation, FDR control).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Expertise in immune receptor immunology (BCR/TCR) and repertoire analytics (clonotyping, lineage tracing, SHM, germline inference).
  • Experience with BCR repertoire analysis (Bulk and/or single cell)
  • Experience with advanced Flow Cytometry and Cell Sorting.
  • Structural biology/protein informatics relevant to antibody-antigen interactions and developability assessment.
  • Experience with complementary fragmentation methods (HCD/ETD/EThcD), intact/middle-down workflows, and disulfide/glycoform mapping.
  • High-performance/parallel computing; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and benchmarking.
  • Prior experience integrating proteomics and repertoire sequencing (immunoproteogenomics)
     

Personal skills
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in an interdisciplinary, ambitious environment.
  • Independent, solution-oriented, and organised; strong scientific rigor and documentation practices
     

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

 

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A scientifically rich, interdisciplinary and international environment at GSK Siena with access to state-of-the-art proteomics and flow cytometry facilities.
  • Advising and mentorship by Prof. Victor Greiff; opportunities for collaboration across immunology, proteomics, and computational teams.
  • Professional development, training, and conference participation.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 640 000 to 760 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter.
  • CV.
  • A complete list of publications.
  • Project/research plan aligned with the position scope
  • Transcripts and certificates.
  • Contact information for 2-3 references.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to  Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

title: assistente alle risorse umane
description: Gi Group, una delle principali agenzie per il lavoro in Italia, per nota azienda, leader nel settore alimentare, ricerchiamo un/una: Payroll & HR Cost Controlling Specialist per gestire il processo di amministrazione del personale e paghe in collaborazione con il provider esterno. La risorsa si occuperà in particolare di Gestione end-to-end del ciclo paghe e contributi in collaborazione con payroll provider esterno. Riconciliazioni budget e verifiche mensili. Simulazioni di scenari di costo e valutazione impatti economico-finanziari. Analisi e pianificazione di schemi di turnazione complessi (ciclo continuo 7/7). Supporto nella valutazione di progetti organizzativi e loro sostenibilità economica. Interfaccia con consulente del lavoro e direzione HR. Competenze richieste Esperienza di almeno 5 anni in amministrazione del personale/payroll in studi professionali e aziende industriali. Approfondita conoscenza della normativa di riferimento, capacità di elaborare cedolini anche senza software, preferibile conoscenza CCNL Alimentare. Gradita conoscenza del software TeamSystem. Orientamento analitico, capacità di ragionamento su scenari finanziari. Precisione, riservatezza, autonomia. Full time - 40h settimanali. Contratto diretto in azienda a tempo indeterminato. Salario lordo mensile: 2000 euro - 2800 euro Sede di lavoro: Catania Facciamo parte di Gi Group Holding (www.gigroupholding.it ) la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, nonché una delle principali realtà a livello mondiale nei servizi dedicati allo sviluppo del mercato del lavoro. Il nostro Gruppo è attivo nei seguenti campi: lavoro temporaneo, Permanent e Professional Staffing, Ricerca e Selezione, Consulenza HR, Formazione, Outsourcing, supporto alla ricollocazione e attività complementari. Siamo presenti in più di 30 Paesi in Europa, Asia e America con un team di oltre 6000 persone. I valori che ci contraddistinguono: attenzione, passione, apprendimento continuo e innovazione, collaborazione, sostenibilità, responsabilità. Consulta tutti i nostri annunci su www.gigroup.it

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: responsabile di deposito
description: Grafton Engineering valorizza competenze e potenziale in ambito Logistica di Cantiere, Supply Chain e Project Delivery. Per Azienda cliente operante su progetti Data Centre, selezioniamo: SITE LOGISTICS SUPERVISOR Di cosa ti occuperai? Sarai il punto di controllo della logistica di cantiere, garantendo flussi ordinati e sicurezza nelle movimentazioni: - mapperai, definirai e governerai aree di stoccaggio on-site/near-site; - assegnerai spazi e priorità in base alle esigenze di progetto; - gestirai il sistema di booking consegne, assicurando slot realistici e aree disponibili; - coordinerai subcontractor e security per accessi, consegne e gestione perimetro; - imposterai e farai rispettare un sistema di call-off che eviti congestioni e interferenze; - monitorerai capacità e utilizzo dei mezzi di sollevamento/trasporto verticale (gru, hoist, ecc.); - guiderai il meeting settimanale consegne, tracciando azioni e responsabilità; - coordinerai le attività con figure dedicate a lifting/crane coordination; - gestirai necessità operative per personale di cantiere (mezzi, parcheggi, accommodation, tracker, ecc.). Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? - esperienza in logistica su cantieri attivi (plus Data Centre); - ottime capacità organizzative e gestione priorità; - comunicazione efficace e fermezza nella gestione regole/slot; - capacità di pianificare 'a tre mosse avanti' e orientamento a sicurezza. - livello fluente di Italiano e Inglese (scritto e parlato) Orario di lavoro: full time (dettagli da definire) Offerta Contrattuale: assunzione diretta a tempo indeterminato CCNL applicato: Elettrici Retribuzione prevista a partire da € 80.000 lordi annui (RAL). Luogo di lavoro: Milano (cantieri Data Centre). Gi Group S.p.A. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro (Aut. Min. 26/11/2004 PROT. 1101 - SG). title: KUĢUBŪVES ATSLĒDZNIEKS
description:
Sabiedrība ar ierobežotu atbildību „Avimar”reģistrācijas numurs:  40203499514

AICINA DARBĀ KUĢUBŪVES ATSLĒDZNIEKUS (profesiju kods 7214 02)


Uzņēmuma darbības joma ir kuģu un peldošo iekārtu būve, kuģu un laivu remonts un apkope, kā arī metāla konstrukciju un to sastāvdaļu ražošana.

Pienākumi:

  • Veikt metāla konstrukciju remontu un izgatavošanu.
  • Veikt dažādu iekārtu un to mezglu montāžu, demontāžu, kā arī atjaunošanu.
  • Veikt aizzīmēšanas, ciršanas, griešanas, vīlēšanas, urbšanas, izrīvēšanas, pielāgošanas, kniedēšanas, liekšanas, presēšanas, slīpēšanas, taisnošanas, valcēšanas, lepēšanas un mērīšanas darbus.
  • Lasīt un izprast tehniskos rasējumus.
  • Ievērot darba aizsardzības un vides aizsardzības prasības.
  • Lietot un sekot līdzi atbilstošajai tehniskajai dokumentācijai.

Prasības:

  • Darba pieredze atbilstošā profesijā vismaz 3 gadi.
  • Bez kaitīgiem ieradumiem.
  • Izpratne par rasējumiem, iekārtām un tehnoloģisko dokumentāciju.
  • Prasme lietot un darbināt pacelšanas iekārtas (ja nepieciešams).
  • Izpratne par dažāda veida kuģu uzbūvi.
  • Prasme strādāt ar gāzes griešanas iekārtām un slīpmašīnām.
  • Spēja strādāt patstāvīgi un komandā.
  • Atbildīga attieksme pret darbu.

title: Ceļu būves palīgSTRĀDNIEKS
description:

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

Il effectue des tâches en lien avec les activités de devis, de soumissions et de décomptes dans le but de respecter l'objectif financier d'un projet immobilier.Il reporte au Chef d'équipe Economistes et travaille quotidien/iennement en étroite collaboration avec le Secrétariat technique, les Experts Qualité et le Contrôleur Financier Chantiers.Tâches principales-       Il établit le suivi budgétaire pour chaque projet attribué et alerte sa hiérarchie en cas d'anomalie grâce à l'établissement d'un rapport, ce dans toutes les phases d'un projet immobilier-       Il contribue à la réussite de la rentabilité d'un projet immobilier en remettant en question les méthodes de travail et les prix proposés-       Il est garant du respect des échéances internes (ex : planning projet immobilier) et externes (ex : échéances administratives) incombant aux tâches dont il est responsable :Phase soumissions :-       Rédige les cahiers des charges et les demandes d'offre sur base des éléments collectés (plans, notices descriptives, standards SNHBM, etc.) y compris pour les offres auprès des bureaux d'études externes-       Rédige l'ensemble des annexes nécessaires au cahier des charges-       Analyse et évalue les soumissions reçues en vue de l'attribution du marché (conformité technique, qualitative et prix)-       Compare les offres ; établit le tableau comparatif des offres reçues et propose l'attribution de chaque marché-       Vérifie le bienfondé, le contenu et les prix proposés des offres supplémentaires demandées au cours d'un projet-       Le cas échéant, négocie les prix et délais des offres supplémentaires-       Tient compte du retour d'expérience des soumissions précédentes pour améliorer le contenu des soumissions en cours et à venir (retour des équipes Développement et Chantiers)-       Participe à la mise à jour systématique de la bibliothèque des textes de soumissions, ce en collaboration avec le Secrétariat technique et la hiérarchie-       Participe à la rédaction de contrats de planification et d'entreprise spécifiques au projet en collaboration avec le Secrétariat Technique et la hiérarchie Phase décomptes :-       Elabore les métrés des différents chantiers attribués tels que prévus dans les contrats signés et dans le respect des délais impartis ; le cas échéant, exécute des métrés contradictoires sur chantier avec les entreprises-       Consulte le Coordinateur de Chantiers pour valider la conformité des matériaux, la qualité des travaux effectués ainsi que la libération du montant réel suivant le plan de financement-       Sur base des métrés effectués, contrôle des factures transmises par les entreprises. En cas de différence constatée, demande la correction des factures aux entreprises concernées-       Libère les factures conformes aux métrés auprès de la Comptabilité pour paiement; en cas de non-respect des délais, il alerte son Chef d'équipe-       Veille au respect des garanties bancaires ainsi que les retenues des garanties-       Communique aux entreprises et vérifie la bonne application des procédures standard en lien avec les Décomptes-       Garantit une communication régulier/ière avec les entreprises (e-mails, courriers) en vue de finaliser le processus de facturation dans les meilleurs délaisTâches supplémentaires-       Contribue aux activités administratives de l'équipe-       Est force de proposition dans le cadre de l'amélioration continue des procédures existant/antesCompétences techniques -       Expérience avérée dans les activités de soumissionnaire en HVAC-Sanitaire ou Electricité-Photovoltaïque et/ou métreur dans le domaine de la construction de maisons unifamiliales et de résidences-       Connaissances du fonctionnement des marchés publics au GDL et de la législation en vigueur-       Utilisation des outils informatiques appropriés-       Compétences analytiques développées-       Etat d'esprit structuré et rigoureuxCompétences managériales et sociales -       Se montre responsable de son travail-       Est doté d'une bonne aisance relationnelle afin de développer et entretenir des relations de travail saines tant en interne qu'en externe-       Affiche un goût prononcé pour le travail en équipe-       Est animé par la volonté de transmission d'expérience (onboarding)Formation & Expérience-       Diplôme de fin d'études en techniques spéciales avec un minimum 5 ans d'expérience ou Formation supérieure en techniques spéciales-       Connaissance...

title: Associate professor (promotion track) in Banking Law (m/f)
description:
Language: English (UK)
Location Luxembourg
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Department of Law
Job Number: UOL07790
Contract Type: Academic - Permanent
Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week

Job (internal): Associate professor
Job Level: Monolevel
Functions: Associate / Assistant Professor
Expertise: Professors
Role Type: Open Position


About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance counts over 2,700 students enrolled across four Bachelor programmes, thirteen Master programmes, doctoral studies as well as several continuing education courses. The Faculty hosts the Doctoral School of Law and the Doctoral School in Economics, Finance and Management.
Teaching and research at the FDEF benefit from the proximity of European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre, as well as its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role
The successful candidate will strengthen the Department of Law's research area in Banking, Financial and Commercial Law, which is a cornerstone of the Department's academic profile and a key contributor to the University's reputation. They will pursue research and teaching in this field, focussing on Luxembourg, EU, and comparative transnational perspectives. The position is of particular strategic relevance given the Department's ambition to maintain its leadership in financial law, a domain central to Luxembourg's role as a global financial centre.
The ideal candidate shows potential to:
• Develop an internationally recognized research profile in banking law in a broad sense, e.g., prudential regulation and bank supervision, depositary law, regulation of payments and payment systems, financial technologies, sustainable finance, secured transactions and consumer financial contracts, links to financial markets law
• Publish extensively in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, monographs, or authoritative treatises
• Contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives such as the FutureFinTechNCER and/or collaborate with the Department of Finance in the field of sustainable finance
• Teach in core areas of banking law. The ability to contribute to teaching in related areas of commercial law—such as financial and securities law, company law, insolvency law, the law of commercial contracts and torts - is an asset
• Cover legal frameworks at both EU and Luxembourg levels, adopting a comparative approach that includes neighbouring jurisdictions and other global financial centres
• Engage with Luxembourg and EU regulators (e.g. CSSF, CBL, ECB, ESMA), international organizations, e.g. IOSCO, BIS, FSB, etc., and other stakeholders, e.g. (inter )national law firms, industry and academic associations
• Acquire competitive research funding and establish and lead their own research team
• Show and develop leadership potential
The candidate will join one of Europe's most prominent academic groups in banking and financial law, distinguished by both its intellectual strength and research output. They will actively contribute to the University's “Third Mission” by engaging with Luxembourg and EU financial law, and will be encouraged to develop into a leadership role within the Department. This position offers the opportunity to gain recognition and respect in Luxembourg's legal community, renowned for its emphasis on financial law expertise and its strong integration of academic insight with professional practice. Their doctoral students will benefit from a strong academic environment and excellent career prospects—more than 20 former PhD graduates from the Department have gone on to become professors.

Your profile
• A Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD degree in Law
• Experience and interest in engaging in academic research at the highest level
• Publications in internationally recognized journals, monographs with international publishers or other publications in banking law (or other fields of financial law) indicating potential for excellent research
• Potential and aptitude for teaching and supervising research at the university level
• An excellent academic track record demonstrating both scholarly excellence and leadership potential
• Experience with externally funded research projects and interdisciplinarity is considered to be an asset
• Experience in interdisciplinary research—particularly at the intersection of law, finance, and technology—is a strong asset
The successful candidate must commit to lecturing banking law, as well as related topics in financial and commercial law, at bachelor and master levels.
The successful candidate is also expected to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, prepare grant applications for external funding and actively engage with other research institutions and industry partners to establish research cooperations in Luxembourg and beyond.
Language requirements:
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and French. Knowledge of German is considered an advantage. The University actively supports language development among its staff and offers access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities.
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance

How to apply
Online application should include:
• Cover letter, to be addressed to the Dean, Katalin Ligeti
• CV, including periods of absence from work such as family-related leave and career breaks
• Statement of future research, teaching and other activities (max 5 pages)
• Short description of the three most important scholarly achievements (max. 2 pages)
• List of publications, research projects acquired, and PhD theses supervised (if applicable)
• List of teaching activities
• Copy of the PhD diploma
• The names, contact information and present position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you
All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. We encourage early application. To ensure full consideration, candidates should apply by of 29/04/2026.

• Contract Type: Academic - Permanent. This position is tenured and promotion to Full Professor is possible after 5 years upon positive evaluation
• Work Hours: Full Time 40.0 Hours per Week
• Planned Start Date: 01.09.2026
• Location: Kirchberg Campus

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organization (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

Describe the main responsibilities of the position.

As a Junior R&T Engineer in the NETCOM group, you will contribute to cutting-edge research on wireless network architectures and distributed communication systems, with applications spanning aerial and space platforms. Under the supervision of experienced researchers and engineers, your main responsibilities will include:
• Network architecture design: Contribute to the definition and modelling of communication network architectures for multi-node distributed systems, including the specification of inter-node link technologies, bandwidth and latency requirements, and Quality of Service (QoS) classes.
• Protocol development: Assist in the design and implementation of cross-layer communication protocols, covering message prioritization, timing constraints, synchronization logic, and fault-tolerant fallback mechanisms for degraded link conditions.
• System integration: Support the definition of data formats and interface specifications required for the integration of communication layers with onboard sensing, processing, and command chain components.
• Simulation and performance evaluation: Develop and run simulation models to evaluate network performance under realistic operational conditions, contributing to the validation and benchmarking of proposed architectural solutions.
• Prototyping and testing: Assist in the implementation and laboratory testing of communication modules, including SDR-based platforms and protocol stacks, contributing to the validation of prototypes in controlled environments.
• Documentation and reporting: Contribute to the drafting of technical deliverables, scientific publications, and presentations at project meetings or conferences.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

• Master's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field.
• Studies covering one or more of the following topics: wireless communication systems and protocols, network architecture and design, distributed systems, artificial intelligence, software-defined networking, or embedded systems.

Experience and skills

• 0 to 2 years of relevant professional or research experience (including internships and Master's thesis work) in wireless networks, communication protocol design, or distributed time-sensitive systems.
• Good understanding of network architecture design principles, including protocol stack design, Quality of Service (QoS), and link management.
• Familiarity with inter-node communication and coordination protocols for distributed or multi-agent systems.
• Knowledge of wireless communication technologies and standards.
• Programming skills in Python, C/C++, or MATLAB for simulation, performance evaluation, and protocol implementation.
• Familiarity with network simulation tools (e.g., ns-3, OMNET++, or equivalent).
• Ability to work under supervision while progressively developing autonomy.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to interpret results and formulate conclusions.
• Collaborative mindset, comfortable working in a multidisciplinary and international consortium environment.

Language skills
• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square meters, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfill their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
• A CV with contact details

Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.

Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.

As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements
For the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.

Due to the requirements of the project, we can only consider applications from nationals of a NATO Member Country, from an EU EEA/EFTA Country or from one of the following NATO Indo-Pacific Partners, Australia, Japan, Republic of South Korea and New Zealand.

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

Describe the main responsibilities of the position.

Refrigeration and air conditioning account for ~17% of global energy consumption, a figure expected to triple by 2050, while contributing over 10% of global greenhouse gas emissions. Conventional vapor-compression cooling relies on high–global-warming-potential refrigerants, creating an urgent need for energy-efficient and environmentally friendly alternatives. Electrocaloric cooling is a promising solid-state technology that can be up to 20% more efficient than vapor-compression systems. It uses ferroelectric materials that undergo a reversible temperature change under an applied electric field. The materials heats upon application and cools upon removal of an electric field. LIST has been working on the topic for some years, specifically developing electrocaloric prototypes based on ceramics and polymers. LIST is recognized as one of the leading institutes in the field.

The role played by materials thermal conductivity on the behaviour of electrocaloric coolers is central to enable a proper understanding of the system. Therefore, this post doc is about studying the thermal conductivity of electrocaloric materials in the context of cooling devices. More specifically, one part will be devoted to the design and fabrication of heat exchangers integrated in electrocaloric coolers. The impact of materials and their thickness will be assessed in specific devices. Another part of this post doc will be devoted to the study of heat switches associated with electrocaloric materials, enabling the design of fluid-free cooling devices.

Other tasks include:

As post-doctoral researcher, you will work in the frame of the SUPHA project funded by the Luxembourg National Research Fund (FNR) through the TREK research program. title: Business Performance Analyst - Cost Control (m/f/n) (H/F)
description: Envie de rejoindre une institution renommée et innovant/ante? Spuerkeess, pilier de la place financier/ière luxembourgeoise avec des notations parmi les meilleures au monde, et employeur de confiance alliant tradition et innovation bancaire depuis , est activement à la recherche d'un nouveau talent. Département :  Finance Service :  Business Performance Management Vos missions Au sein du département Finance, vous rejoignez le service Business Performance Manangement (contrôle de gestion) en tant qu'analyste. Votre mission principale consiste à traiter analytiquement les coûts de la banque, à les analyser et à les challenger ainsi que de contribuer à l'évaluation financier/ière des projets et initiatives. title: Ingénieur Sécurité Incendie & Sécurité des Bâtiments (H/F)
description: Harry Hope, cabinet de recrutement accompagne candidats et entreprises dans leurs recherches des meilleures opportunités en France et à l'international. Afin de mieux répondre à vos enjeux, tous nos consultants sont spécialisés par secteur d'activité et zone géographique.
