Senior Specialist \- Regenerative Agriculture  
Location: Vers\-chez\-les\-Blanc, Switzerland  
Work model: Hybrid / Full time  
Contract type / duration: Permanent  
Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.  
As a Senior Specialist \- Regenerative Agriculture at Nestlé Research, your mission is to provide strategic direction and leadership in regenerative agriculture research, with a focus on coffee and cocoa. You'll make a difference by collaborating closely with researchers, agronomists, project teams, business partners, operations teams, markets, and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.  
How you'll make an impact as a Senior Specialist \- Regenerative Agriculture  
Defining scientific priorities that strengthen regenerative agriculture research and support sustainability and climate goals.  
Leading a research project portfolio that turns regenerative agriculture science into practical solutions for coffee and cocoa value chains.  
Driving collaborations with internal and external partners to address complex agronomy, soil health, and crop management challenges.  
Delivering research projects, trials, and budgets with strong planning, governance, and operational excellence.  
Building global regenerative agriculture capabilities by connecting experts, resources, and knowledge across teams and regions.  
Communicating clear scientific insights, recommendations, and proposals that influence decisions and accelerate impact.  
What will make you successful  
Bringing a solid research background in agronomy (PhD or equivalent experience), preferably focused on sustainable coffee and cocoa production systems, with additional experience in integrated pest management and soil fertility management or a related field a plus.  
Applying scientific knowledge to translate research and technology into practical solutions for implementation in agricultural value chains.  
Using end\-to\-end research project management to connect regenerative agriculture with business value.  
Collaborating effectively across research, business, operations, market, and external partner networks to build alignment and trust.  
Communicating fluently in English and Spanish (ideally); working proficiency in French,  
Bringing creative thinking, bold hypotheses, and creative solutions combined with a respectful, positive mindset.  
At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.  
Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:  
Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)  
Paid holidays beyond legal requirements  
Learning and development opportunities to grow your career  
Performance based bonus  
Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program  
Strong employer contribution to your pension plan  
Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions  
Attractive employee discounts across various products and services  
What to expect from our hiring process  
We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.  
The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.  
Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Leading food service operations across restaurants, catering, retail concepts and coffee corners to deliver smooth, high\-quality service every day.

description:
Nous allons réaliser ensemble  
Chargé\-e technico\-commercial\-e  
Nous allons réaliser ensemble  
En tant que Chargé·e technico commercial·e, vous apportez un soutien et une expertise technico commerciale au front office en concevant et proposant des solutions adaptées aux besoins des client·es.  
Rattachée à l’unité Solutions Clients et Partenaires, vous contribuez au développement de solutions énergétiques en coordination avec les équipes commerciales, marketing et techniques. L’unité soutient les chargé·es de client·es, développe des solutions adaptées et anime un réseau de partenaires afin de renforcer la dynamique économique locale.  
Votre énergie au service d’une Genève durable  
Dans le cadre de votre fonction vous serez amené·e à :  
Contribuer à l’étude de faisabilité technique des projets clients et à l’élaboration des offres associées ;  
Coordonner la construction des offres en lien avec les parties prenantes internes ;  
Identifier les enjeux financiers et commerciaux des client·es afin de proposer des solutions pertinentes ;  
Proposer des solutions thermiques innovantes, adaptées et compétitives ;  
Participer à la négociation des conditions commerciales et au respect des engagements contractuels ;  
Présenter les solutions technico commerciales et contribuer aux échanges en réunions de zones RTS.  
Votre personnalité et vos compétences  
Doté·e d’un excellent relationnel, vous entretenez une relation de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs et faites preuve d’un fort esprit d’équipe. Organisé·e et orienté·e solutions, vous savez gérer les priorités et mener plusieurs projets simultanément avec autonomie. Résistant·e au stress, agile et à l’aise dans des environnements en évolution, vous adoptez une attitude positive et collaborative.  
Vous disposez d’une solide culture technique et commerciale dans les domaines thermique, solaire et de l’électromobilité. Vous maîtrisez les techniques de négociation et faites preuve d’un bon esprit d’analyse. Vous possédez également des connaissances en gestion financière de projets et êtes à l’aise dans l’animation de groupes de travail technico commerciaux.  
Votre parcours académique  
Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme d’Ingénieur·e EPF ou HES, spécialisé·e dans le domaine thermique, et justifiez de 5 à 6 ans d’expérience dans une activité commerciale, idéalement dans le secteur de l’énergie.  
Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des marchés publics et privés du territoire genevois ainsi que de la Suisse romande. Une expérience dans un bureau d’ingénieurs ou dans les métiers de l’énergie constitue un atout.  
Rejoindre SIG, c’est participer au changement !  
SIG est une entreprise publique de proximité au service de la population, des entreprises et des collectivités publiques genevoises. Elle fournit un large panel de prestations dans la distribution des énergies, de l’eau et de la valorisation des déchets. Elle s'engage, en tant que bras industriel de l'Etat de Genève, en faveur d'une transition écologique ambitieuse.  
Soucieuse de promouvoir l’égalité entre femmes et hommes ainsi que la diversité au sein de ses équipes, notre institution encourage les candidatures de toutes et tous, indépendamment de leur genre, de leur origine ou de toute autre caractéristique personnelle.  
Dans les domaines où les femmes sont actuellement sous\-représentées, les candidatures féminines sont particulièrement encouragées.

title: Access Executive Director
description:
Location: Strong preference to be based in one of the five MSF Access Regional Hubs (Rio de Janeiro, Dakar, Brussels, Nairobi, and Kuala Lumpur). Placement in associated strategic locations may be considered.

Duration: MSF office contract, minimum 3 years commitment, extendable by 3 years, according to MSF practice and subject to national labour laws

Compensation and benefits: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract.

Reporting to: The MSF Access Executive Board

Start date: Beginning of Q3 2026 preferred with some flexibility depending on individual circumstances

MSF INTERNATIONAL
Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND
Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign. In 2023, MSF’s International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:
“Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work.”
Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF’s access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION
The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access’s mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION
The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED’s role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
The Executive Director’s primary responsibilities will include:
Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability
Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access

title: Assistant Professorship tenure track for Climate Research
description:
Assistant Professorship tenure track for Climate Research  
We are seeking candidates at the intersection of climate research and geography. You have expertise in concepts and theories related to climate interactions with respect to present and future environments. You have demonstrable skills in the modelling and analysis of spatio\-temporal variability of climate and associated uncertainties. You have experience in integrating climate change scenarios and model outputs in your work (e.g., for informing climate adaptation). Your research shows evidence of open and reproducible research practices, and you have an interest in communicating the results of your work to policymakers and the public. You have a developing track record in terms of research output, acquisition of third\-party funding, and teaching and mentoring.  
Assistant Professorship tenure track for Climate Research  
Autumn 2027 (negotiable)  
As a future assistant professor, you will strengthen the scientific impact and societal role of the Department of Geography (GIUZ). You will also contribute to teaching and its further development at both Bachelor and Master levels, in both Geography and Earth Systems Science, in particular introducing our students to the fundamentals of atmosphere and climate, and teaching on topics such as climate impacts, statistical data analysis or climate extremes. You will teach in English and German, and if you have not already mastered German you are prepared to do so in the future. You will supervise Master and PhD students in topics related to your field.  
UZH sees researchers as modern leaders who conduct excellent research through their own research projects and the promotion of excellent junior researchers, who constructively work with university administration and who help to shape a future\-oriented University with innovative research\-based teaching. Situated in the open\-minded and family\-friendly city of Zurich, which combines the vibrant cultural scene of a modern European city with the convenient accessibility to its beautiful natural surroundings, UZH is well integrated in the city's community and research environment.  
UZH provides generous research support, including dedicated funds for personnel and operating expenses, and competitive start\-up packages. Additionally, the successful applicant is expected to acquire external research funding. Zurich's scientific environment encompasses a rich spectrum of diverse activities.  
The employment conditions for this position follow UZH's legal regulations and include part\-time options. UZH is an equal\-opportunities employer, and the Faculty of Science, in particular, strives to increase the percentage of women and underrepresented groups in leading positions. Therefore, qualified female researchers are particularly encouraged to apply. Care\-time interruptions are considered during the evaluation of applicants of all genders.

title: Access Executive Director
description:
Location: Strong preference to be based in one of the five MSF Access Regional Hubs (Rio de Janeiro, Dakar, Brussels, Nairobi, and Kuala Lumpur). Placement in associated strategic locations may be considered.

Duration: MSF office contract, minimum 3 years commitment, extendable by 3 years, according to MSF practice and subject to national labour laws

Compensation and benefits: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract.

Reporting to: The MSF Access Executive Board

Start date: Beginning of Q3 2026 preferred with some flexibility depending on individual circumstances

MSF INTERNATIONAL
Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND
Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign. In 2023, MSF’s International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:
“Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work.”
Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF’s access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION
The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access’s mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION
The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED’s role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
The Executive Director’s primary responsibilities will include:
Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability
Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access
Leading development, implementation, monitoring and periodic revision of the MSF Access Strategic Plan by means of the annual/multi-year plan and budget
Executive leadership of the MSF Access team, including management of the MSF Access management team alongside the Deputy Executive Director

Final responsibility for, ongoing engagement with and reporting on the strategic progress, performance, annual budgets and expenditures, and risk mitigation strategies of MSF Access to the Executive Board, and when necessary, other MSF leadership and decision-making platforms such as the Full Executive Committee

Promoting processes for reflection, learning and continuous improvement across MSF Access

External Representation and Engagement

title: Lead - Archive Management
description:
In short
We are establishing our first-ever Product Archive at our Zurich HQ and are ready to transition from vision to reality. We are looking for a visionary Product Archive Lead to spearhead this effort and drive it into its operational phase.

As an incredible self-starter with deep roots in the cultural sector, you will be the custodian of our Design heritage. With the Archive you will manage a dynamic, multi-faceted ecosystem: serving as an internal creative engine for our designers, an external-facing cultural landmark in the heart of Zurich, and a secure digital repository for our innovation. This is an opportunity to bridge our rich history with our future creative ambitions, turning our archive into a world-class inspiration hub.

Your Mission
- Establish the Center of Competence: Define and execute a holistic archive strategy. You will develop the criteria for our collection, ensuring it serves as a rigorous, authoritative, and accessible knowledge base that fuels internal research and preserves our brand DNA for the long term.
- Oversee Physical Stewardship: Manage the full lifecycle of our physical collections. This includes depot planning, organization, and qualification processes, as well as the identification and documentation of previously unrecorded object groups (shoes, textiles, accessories) and long-term conservation.
- Drive Digital & Data Infrastructure: Architect our digital repository. You will lead the implementation and integration of archive databases, ensuring seamless data flow with internal systems, and overseeing metadata standards (keywording, photo documentation) to make our history searchable and usable.
- Bridge the Past, Present, and Future: Partner with Design and Product teams to establish the archive as a functional, high-access creative engine. You will build the workflows that allow teams to search, borrow, and analyze historical product references, ensuring our past innovations directly inform and inspire current seasonal concepts.
- Collaborate on Cultural Engagement: Partner with our exhibition programming team to position the archive as a cultural landmark. You will provide the necessary historical context, exhibit curation, and material expertise to bring our brand stories to life through internal and external showcases.
- Operational Excellence: Manage the archive’s working budget, vendor relationships, and IT collaborations to ensure the archive functions as a high-performance, future-proof service.

Your story
- Heritage & Cultural Expert: You possess a deep background in managing high-value archives, heritage collections, or design museums (6-8 years of experience). You are comfortable engaging with the cultural sector and understand how to translate institutional history into a compelling modern narrative.
- Meticulous & Precise: Your approach is defined by rigorous organization. You thrive in the details of inventory management, documentation, and data standards, ensuring that every object in our care is perfectly accounted for and categorized.
- Systems Thinker: You are as comfortable with database architecture as you are with physical conservation. You can define, implement, and maintain complex systems that ensure data flows seamlessly from our past into our digital tools.
- Collaborative & Communicative: You are a natural bridge-builder. You possess the diplomacy to work across departments—from IT and Finance to Design and Marketing—and you thrive in a team environment where knowledge-sharing is the priority.
- Narrative Driven: You excel at bringing our heritage to life, transforming archival records into compelling stories. You have a unique ability to uncover the "why" behind past design decisions and can translate that historical context into actionable, relevant insights for designers working today.
- Strategic Self-Starter: You don’t wait for instructions to build a process. You are an autonomous project lead who can manage budgets, external vendors, and multi-year timelines with the agility required in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

About the Team
You will report directly to the Chief of Staff (CoS) of Design, sitting at the heart of a vibrant and diverse Design Studio that drives On’s disruptive product design across footwear, apparel, and accessories. We are a team that values creativity, curiosity, and collaboration, and we are looking for someone who shares our passion for turning the "why" of our past into the "what's next" of our future.

title: Assistant Professorship tenure track for Climate Research
description:
Assistant Professorship tenure track for Climate Research  
We are seeking candidates at the intersection of climate research and geography. You have expertise in concepts and theories related to climate interactions with respect to present and future environments. You have demonstrable skills in the modelling and analysis of spatio\-temporal variability of climate and associated uncertainties. You have experience in integrating climate change scenarios and model outputs in your work (e.g., for informing climate adaptation). Your research shows evidence of open and reproducible research practices, and you have an interest in communicating the results of your work to policymakers and the public. You have a developing track record in terms of research output, acquisition of third\-party funding, and teaching and mentoring.  
Assistant Professorship tenure track for Climate Research  
Autumn 2027 (negotiable)  
As a future assistant professor, you will strengthen the scientific impact and societal role of the Department of Geography (GIUZ). You will also contribute to teaching and its further development at both Bachelor and Master levels, in both Geography and Earth Systems Science, in particular introducing our students to the fundamentals of atmosphere and climate, and teaching on topics such as climate impacts, statistical data analysis or climate extremes. You will teach in English and German, and if you have not already mastered German you are prepared to do so in the future. You will supervise Master and PhD students in topics related to your field.  
UZH sees researchers as modern leaders who conduct excellent research through their own research projects and the promotion of excellent junior researchers, who constructively work with university administration and who help to shape a future\-oriented University with innovative research\-based teaching. Situated in the open\-minded and family\-friendly city of Zurich, which combines the vibrant cultural scene of a modern European city with the convenient accessibility to its beautiful natural surroundings, UZH is well integrated in the city's community and research environment.  
UZH provides generous research support, including dedicated funds for personnel and operating expenses, and competitive start\-up packages. Additionally, the successful applicant is expected to acquire external research funding. Zurich's scientific environment encompasses a rich spectrum of diverse activities.  
The employment conditions for this position follow UZH's legal regulations and include part\-time options. UZH is an equal\-opportunities employer, and the Faculty of Science, in particular, strives to increase the percentage of women and underrepresented groups in leading positions. Therefore, qualified female researchers are particularly encouraged to apply. Care\-time interruptions are considered during the evaluation of applicants of all genders.  
What we offer  
Our employees benefit from a wide range of attractive offers.  
Location  
Department of Geography  
Information on your application  
Applicants are kindly invited to submit their applications, which should include:  
a cover letter (. 1 page)  
a Curriculum Vitae with date of submission, including teaching and supervisory track record; outreach activities; a list of acquired competitive funding, including role and amount awarded to the candidate  
a description of their research outputs relevant for this application and their importance for the field (at most five outputs, . 1 page in total)  
a research plan describing their mid\-term scientific strategy and expected impact (. 2 pages)  
a teaching reflection on their educational values, tools and methods, and their potential contribution to the curriculum development at UZH (. 1 page)  
a description of their track record and/or planned measures towards diversity, equality, inclusion, and sustainability (. 0\.5 page)  
a list of publications and other research outputs, including dataset, code, etc.  
a copy of their PhD certificate  
Please note that page limitations do not include references.  
The evaluation processes at UZH and its Faculty of Science follow the DORA recommendations for assessing research quality and impact. Applicants are thus asked to refrain from referring to non\-personal measures such as impact factors.  
Please upload your application to by 31 August 2026\. The interviews will take place on 05 and 06 November 2026\.  
For further information, please contact Prof. Dr. Ross Purves ([Write an email](<>)).

title: Research Engineer - Nanofabrication 80-100%
description:
Research Engineer \- Nanofabrication 80\-100%  
The Institute PSI is the largest research institute for natural and engineering sciences within Switzerland. We perform cutting\-edge research in the fields of future technologies, energy and climate, health innovation and fundamentals of nature. By performing fundamental and applied research, we work on sustainable solutions for major challenges facing society, science and economy. PSI is committed to the training of future generations. Therefore, about one quarter of our staff are post\-docs, post\-graduates or apprentices. Altogether, PSI employs 2300 people.  
Enable cutting\-edge research through world\-class nanofabrication infrastructure  
The Nanotechnology Group at the Institute (PSI) is looking for a motivated Research Engineer \- Nanofabrication to support the operation and continuous development of the PICO (Park Innovaare Cleanroom for Optics and Innovation) facility.  
This interdisciplinary position combines hands\-on cleanroom work, software development, scientific instrumentation, and research infrastructure management. Approximately half of your time will be spent working in the cleanroom, while the other half will focus on developing and maintaining the digital infrastructure that enables efficient operation of the facility.  
Rather than supporting a single research project, you will help build and continuously improve the infrastructure that enables hundreds of researchers from academia and industry to perform world\-class science.  
Research Engineer \- Nanofabrication 80\-100%  
Your tasks  
Develop and optimize nanofabrication processes with a focus on direct\-write laser lithography and wet chemical processing  
Become the technical expert and equipment owner for the DWL lithography systems and additional cleanroom equipment, including commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, upgrades, and user support  
Develop, improve, and maintain the software infrastructure supporting cleanroom operation, including the time\-tracking system used for facility access management and billing, process database and PICO website  
Provide technical and administrative support to cleanroom users, organize user training, and contribute to a positive user experience within an international research environment  
Ensure accurate documentation, facility usage tracking, and invoicing according to the requirements of different funding agencies  
Diagnose technical problems on laboratory equipment and, whenever feasible, repair electronic and mechanical issues  
Support collaborative R\&D projects with PSI research groups as well as academic and industrial partners  
Contribute to the continuous improvement of the PICO cleanroom infrastructure and its digital ecosystem  
Your profile  
We are looking for a person who enjoys building reliable research infrastructure and continuously improving laboratory operations. Success in this position requires curiosity, technical versatility, and a systematic way of working.  
A Master's degree (MSc) or equivalent in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Microengineering, Nanotechnology, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline  
Enthusiasm for combining cleanroom work with software development, scientific instrumentation, and research infrastructure  
Experience programming in and an interest in developing scientific software. Experience with PHP, databases, web technologies, or software automation is an advantage  
A structured, systematic, and detail\-oriented working style. You enjoy maintaining accurate documentation and organizing operational processes such as facility usage tracking and invoicing  
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, ideally with experience diagnosing and/or repairing laboratory or electronic equipment  
Excellent communication skills and a service\-oriented mindset. You enjoy working with researchers from diverse scientific backgrounds and helping them succeed  
Experience with cleanroom technologies is required, direct\-write lithography, or semiconductor processing is a strong advantage  
Excellent command of English. German language skills are an advantage  
We offer  
A highly interdisciplinary role combining nanofabrication, software engineering, scientific instrumentation, and research infrastructure  
The opportunity to become the technical expert for state\-of\-the\-art direct\-write laser lithography systems and other advanced cleanroom equipment  
A modern cleanroom facility supporting leading\-edge research in nanotechnology, quantum technologies, photonics, microfabrication, and advanced materials  
Collaboration with internationally recognized researchers and industrial partners  
A stimulating working environment with a high degree of independence, responsibility, and opportunities for professional development  
Competitive employment conditions at one of Europe's leading multidisciplinary research institutes  
If you enjoy combining engineering, software development, cleanroom work, and user interaction, and would like to help build the research infrastructure that enables tomorrow's scientific breakthroughs, we look forward to receiving your application.

Please submit your application online for the position as a Research Engineer \- Nanofabrication 80\-100% (Index\-Nr. ).

title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
description:
Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  
Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.  
The Department of Process Engineering (ENG) has a vacancy for a  
Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  
Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  
The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.  
This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in Sumo, which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design.  
We are looking for a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. The preferred starting date is September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\.

We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our R&D team and bring your passion and talent to work.

VP, Head System Solutions R&D (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution
In this pivotal leadership role, you will drive the strategic direction of System Solutions R&D for Tecan’s complex life sciences and medical technology portfolio. You will shape the system architecture vision, oversee multidisciplinary teams, and ensure the integrity and excellence of our products across hardware, software, applications, automation, and regulated workflows. From concept to market launch and lifecycle management, you will be the senior leader ensuring our solutions are safe, effective, and ready for the world.

•    Set standards for requirements engineering, interface management, and system integration across multidisciplinary teams.
•    Partner with PMO, Product Management, Marketing, and Business Leaders to shape portfolio strategy and define product roadmaps.

•    Provide executive technical oversight for integration, system verification, and release readiness decisions.
•    Build and grow technical leadership within the function, including hiring, performance management, and talent development.
•    Foster strong partnerships across functions and represent System Solutions in executive reviews and governance forums.
•    Promote a culture of continuous improvement, technical excellence, and innovation.
Your background
We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.
•    Degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
•    Advanced business education or a business degree is a nice to have.
•    15+ years of progressive experience in systems engineering, product development, and innovation within life sciences, diagnostics, medical devices, or other highly regulated industries.
•    Proven success leading system architecture and cross-functional technical execution for complex multidisciplinary products.
•    Strong track record of building and leading high-performing teams in global, matrixed organizations.
•    Demonstrated senior leadership experience in building and developing multidisciplinary R&D organizations.
•    Skilled at coaching, mentoring, and developing technical leaders within the organization.
•    Comfortable leading across geographies and cultures, promoting diversity and inclusion.
•    Excellent communication and influencing skills in English; additional languages are an advantage.
•    Experience with digital/data-driven products or AI-assisted workflows is a plus.
•    Willingness to travel internationally (10%)

What makes working at Tecan unique
The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow
•    Working in an international and diverse environment
•    The chance to grow your career within the company
•    Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture
•    Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work.

r letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

title: Senior RF Integrated Circuit (RFIC) Design Engineer
description:
Location: Zurich, Switzerland
Department: Hardware Engineering / IC Design
Employment Type: Full-Time

About Us
At ARGUS SPACE, we are shaping the future of connectivity. We design next-generation wireless communication systems that power everything from 5G/6G infrastructure, satellite communications, to radar systems. We pride ourselves on a culture of innovation, collaboration, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in silicon.
We are looking for a visionary Senior RFIC Design Engineer to join our world-class engineering team. In this role, you will lead the architecture, design, and tape-out of high-performance RF and mixed-signal integrated circuits that will define the industry standard.

Key Responsibilities
.Architecture & Design: Lead the micro-architecture and transistor-level design of RF blocks (e.g., LNAs, PAs, Mixers, VCOs, PLLs, and Baseband Filters) in advanced semiconductor technologies (CMOS, SiGe, or GaAs).
.Simulation & Verification: Perform rigorous circuit-level simulations, including PVT variations, Monte Carlo analysis, and stability analysis, to ensure robust performance.
.EM Modeling: Conduct electromagnetic (EM) simulations of on-chip passives, transmission lines, and IC packages using tools like HFSS or EMX.
.Layout Oversight: Work closely with layout engineers to guide floor planning, parasitic extraction, and matching techniques to minimize noise and coupling.
.Silicon Characterization: Partner with the lab evaluation team to characterize, debug, and validate your designs on silicon, ensuring alignment with simulated specs.
.Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior and mid-level design engineers.

What We Are Looking For (Requirements)
•Education: Master’s or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering (or a related field) with a focus on RF/Microwave IC design.
•Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in RFIC design with a proven track record of successful tape-outs.

Technical Skills:
.Deep understanding of RF/microwave engineering principles, transmission lines, impedance matching, and noise theory.
.Expertise with EDA tools (Cadence Virtuoso, SpectreRF, ADS, or GoldenGate).
.Solid grasp of deep sub-micron semiconductor device physics and layout parasitics.
.Soft Skills: Exceptional problem-solving abilities, strong communication skills, and a collaborative team-first mindset.

Nice-to-Haves
.Experience with advanced nodes (FinFET or FD-SOI).
.Familiarity with high-frequency packaging techniques (Flip-chip, WLCSP, Wire bond).
.Knowledge of wireless standards such as Wi-Fi 7, 5G-NR, or UWB.

What We Offer
.Competitive Salary: Highly competitive base salary and equity/stock options.
.Growth & Tools: Access to state-of-the-art EDA tools, cutting-edge lab equipment.

How to Apply
Ready to build the future of wireless tech? Send your resume and a summary of your recent tape-out experience to jobs@argus-space.ch with the subject line "Senior RFIC Design Engineer – [Your Name]".

ARGUS SPACE is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.

**Background Screening and Security Checks**

As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.

For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.

The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.

title: Boarding Assistant
description:
From September 2026 to June 2027


OUR PHILOSOPHY

At Beau Soleil, we believe it’s what you do that counts. This philosophy holds true in all that we do as staff and for our students. We are a community that believes in the power of action, engagement and participation, inside and outside of the classroom.

Our unique holistic education is built around four core values: Respect, Responsibility, Ambition and Determination, which provide a framework to community life for our international student body. Our students come from over sixty different countries, with diverse academic backgrounds and a wide range of future aspirations.

With curricular programmes in both English and French, students graduate with an IB or High School Diploma. Within this framework, small class sizes allow for a flexible programme and staff are encouraged and supported to bring new ideas to all that they do.


OUR COMMUNITY

Our location in the heart of Villars-sur-Ollon, offers an enviable lifestyle with access to skiing in the winter months and a multitude of outdoor and sporting activities throughout the year. Montreux, Lausanne and Geneva are all within easy reach for cultural adventures and inspiration.

The Beau Soleil campus is an inspiring place to work with facilities that are second to none. Our ongoing campus development and maintenence programme ensures that our students and staff thrive in an environment of which they can be rightly proud.


YOUR PROFILE

We are looking for a caring, reliable and enthusiastic Boarding Assistant to join our community.

Working closely with the Housemaster/mistress (HM) and Deputy Housemaster/mistress (DHM), you will help foster a warm and supportive atmosphere — a true “home away from home” where students feel comfortable, respected and motivated to reach their full potential.

As a constant presence in the house, you will play an essential role in the daily life of our students — offering guidance, encouragement and a listening ear. Whether you are helping with studies, joining in evening activities or simply sharing everyday moments, your contribution will help make boarding life both meaningful and memorable.

This residential position offers a unique opportunity to become part of a vibrant international community and to gain valuable experience in pastoral care, education and youth development. It’s particularly suited to recent graduates or young professionals who are compassionate, responsible and eager to make a positive difference in the lives of young people.

At Beau Soleil, you’ll help shape an environment where kindness and effort are celebrated, curiosity is encouraged, and every student feels truly at home — a place where both students and staff can grow and flourish.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Working with the HM and DHM to ensure the successful running of the house to provide the best possible care and experience for the students in the house
- Getting to know the students in the house and supporting them as individuals
- Being an active, dynamic and positive presence in the house during the course of the day and evening
- Assisting with house administration as required
- Extensive involvement in the weekend programme
- 6-8 lessons a week supporting in lessons
- Supporting two activities or sports teams across the year
- Overnight supervision in the Boarding House
- Helping at La Sionnaire during the Winter season (chalet on the ski slopes)
- Study supervision
- Working alongside the Health Centre team to provide support and take students to doctors/dental appointments
- Reception duties
- Airport transfers
- Attend weekly Training and Support Meetings
- Any other duties which may be required from time to time by the School


EDUCATION AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

- Qualified to degree level
- English native speaker or high level of English comprehension. Good level of French is helpful but not essential
- Good IT skills


EXPERIENCE

- Experience of working with young people in a residential setting is helpful but not essential


PERSON SPECIFICATION

- Enthusiasm and willingness to get involved in a wide variety of activities
- A team player
- Proactive and willing to take the initiative
- Confident communication skills
- Good organisation and planning skills
- A good sense of humour
- Ability to form good working relationships within the house team, boarding team and across the school
- Willingness to follow an internal CPD programme during the course of the year
- European passport holder for compliance with Swiss work permit regulations


WHAT WE OFFER

- A 10-month fixed contract, from September 2026 to June 2027
- Accommodation is included for the duration of your contract (subject to social charges)
- Food is included during term time (subject to social charges)
- Basic health insurance (Lamal) is provided and paid for by the College
- Full season ski pass and equipment hire provided



START DATE

From September 2026 to 30 June 2027.


HOW TO APPLY

Applications should be made via Beau Soleil recruitment website,https://www.beausoleil.ch/careers and should contain a CV, letter of application and the details of two professional referees.

The closing date for applications is Wednesday, 5 August 2026.

Successful short listed candidates will be contacted straight away with initial discussions conducted remotely by telephone or video call.
Collège Alpin Beau Soleil is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. A police check is required prior to appointment.
